House Republicans just released their new budget, _and it’s a disaster for working families, Peter._

Instead of investing in programs that help people get ahead, **they’re proposing deep cuts to Medicaid and SNAP** – programs that provide essential healthcare and food assistance to millions of Americans.

And what do they want to do with all the money they’re “saving”? **Hand out even more tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations – while adding trillions to the national debt.**

Let’s be clear: This is a choice. The GOP is choosing to take healthcare away from children, seniors, and people with disabilities so their biggest donors and corporate special interests can get richer. That’s not responsible governing – it’s cruel, it’s reckless, and it’s completely out of touch with the best interests of Americans.

Kim has spent her career fighting to protect affordable healthcare, and she won’t back down now. But she needs you with her. Hi Derek, it's Chrissy.

Every day, sometimes every few hours, there's a new headline that makes me angry and long for a President Kamala Harris. If you’re like me, you’re a little scared, a lot anxious, and trying to do everything you can to stop the reckless and dangerous actions of President Trump, Elon Musk, and those around them.

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: BREAKING: We’re taking Trump Back to Court
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTIxNTI1MjYS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjE2MDI5MTgwMwS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
BREAKING NEWS, Peter, We never thought we’d be here, but we’re back in court after filing a lawsuit
against the Trump administration. On his first day in office, Trump issued an order to revoke federal protection
of millions of acres of public waters from future oil and gas development. We
know offshore drilling threatens our environment, public health, coastal
economies, fisheries, vital marine ecosystems, and even national security. Trump’s order also attempts to undo protections of the Chukchi Sea and the
Beaufort Sea in the Arctic as well as the deepwater canyon areas in the north
and mid-Atlantic. We need your help, Peter. Rush a gift to LCV today and ensure Trump cannot roll back these vital environmental protections. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ambdF6Y4~ Are you feeling déjà vu? It’s because this has happened before. In 2017, LCV — as part of a coalition of conservation organizations — filed our
first-ever lawsuit to take Trump to court over the exact same executive orderto expand offshore drilling in key areas within the Arctic and Atlantic Oceans
that President Obama protected, known as LCV v. Trump. A federal judge BLOCKED the Trump administration from moving forward with
their reckless plan. Beating Trump is going to take a combined effort from all parts of the
environmental movement. It will take intense lobbying efforts in Congress. It
will take organizing efforts in communities around the country. And it will take
legal work to block his agenda in the courts. At this moment, we truly need to
use every tool in our toolbox. Don’t wait, Peter, give to LCV and take on the Trump administration’s continuous attacks on our waters. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/7RYwsXme_ We shouldn’t need to file this suit again — Trump already lost the last time he
tried this. But we are standing firm in our commitment to defending coastal
communities and waters from risky and dirty offshore drilling, and we’re
signaling to the Trump administration, Congress, and the people of this country
that we won’t back down. Thanks for being with us, and let’s go win together. Onward, Gene Karpinski
President

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? _

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102422264/529145416/-840760079?refcode=BLU_EM_SAN_2025-02-19_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODI2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzEwNGFmOC0yM2VmLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=16ZA5dqHl8b7vTC3Qh6qA65ce4qT_7N3rS8A7CS_cIM=)

| Peter,

Before I ran for Congress, I worked for the IBEW, and as a proud union member, I’ll be damned if I’m gonna let anybody attack hardworking Americans.

President Trump and Elon Musk are breaking the law; they don’t have the right to shut down agencies that were created by Congress or fire civil servants to replace them with loyalists.

Elon Musk and Donald Trump were born with silver spoons in their mouths. That’s why they think they own everything, but that doesn’t make them entitled to destroy our government or our democracy. Or entitled to destroy the lives of everyone who relies on federal workers: travelers who rely on TSA agents to keep our flights safe, veterans who depend on the VA for benefits, parents who want to know their kids' schools are well-funded and their food is safe to eat, and seniors who rely on their Social Security checks to come in on time.

We don't want to see any nonprofit bludgeoned and silenced for dissent -- especially not one dedicated to protecting and expanding our right to vote. This dangerous bill needs to be stopped before bad actors are empowered to weaponize the tax code against organizations they don't agree with.
Please, RUSH $25 or more today to stop this "chilling" bill before it's too late >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=021925_2&amount=25]

Truthout: House Passes Chilling “Nonprofit Killer” Bill [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=021925_2&amount=25]
We've got to let you know, Team, that a bill that would give President Donald Trump broad powers to target his political foes passed in the U.S. House of Representatives last Congress and is sure to come up again.
The bill, last known as H.R. 9495, would empower the Treasury secretary to unilaterally designate any nonprofit as a “terrorist supporting organization” and revoke its tax-exempt status, effectively killing the group. The bill could give presidential administrations a tool to crack down on organizations for political reasons.
“ Authoritarianism is not born overnight — it creeps in ,” Rep. Lloyd Doggett said on the House floor. “ A tyrant tightens his grip not just by seizing power, but when he demands new powers and when those who can stop him willingly cede and bend to his will .” “ A sixth grader would know this is unconstitutional ,” added Rep. Jamie Raskin.
Unconstitutional and authoritarian or not, this bill has passed the House once and has a good chance of passing both houses of Congress now that opponents of voting rights have total control of our government. That's why we need to start working now to prevent this bill from ever becoming law.

* **TOP NEWS**

"**West Texas measles outbreak climbs to 58, with four saying they were vaccinated,** " Texas Tribune's**Ayden Runnels** -- "An outbreak of measles in West Texas has grown to 58 cases, including four patients who said they were vaccinated against the disease.

Ten more cases were added to the Department of State Health Services' count Tuesday, including for the first time the four who self-reported they were vaccinated against the disease, according to the agency's [latest update](https://substack.com/redirect/c765de8b-7e5b-4e6e-9a94-8d0716617f3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). A spokesperson with DSHS said health investigators are in the process of confirming whether the four were, in fact, vaccinated against measles and how many doses they may have received.

DSHS [initially warned](https://substack.com/redirect/5429bcac-7759-4942-9a3a-a9363cd8ab1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of two cases of measles in underage children in Gaines County in late January. The disease has since spread to four other counties and 58 people -- most of whom are children -- but 45 of the cases are still in Gaines County. Lubbock County, which reported a single case, is the largest county in which a case was reported.

Thirteen patients have been hospitalized, according to DSHS, and spokesperson **Lara Anton** said officials are still unsure what the initial source of exposure was. The outbreak is Texas' largest in more than 30 years, and comes at a time where vaccination rates among children [have dropped](https://substack.com/redirect/38aefe53-020a-45b6-a777-def90a142415?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Almost 97% of Texas kindergarteners were vaccinated against measles in 2019, compared to 94.3% in 2024, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/82386a3d-f105-4e42-a150-a9f5cf0e9cbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Despite the increase in infections among those potentially vaccinated, a DSHS spokesperson said virologists do not currently see "any evidence" the measles virus present in the patients has mutated into a vaccine-resistant variant.

The measles, mumps and rubella vaccine, commonly referred to as the MMR vaccine, is about 93% effective with one dose and 97% effective with two doses, according to the CDC. The first dose is usually administered to infants aged 12 to 15 months, while the second dose is given to kids between 4 and 6. Follow-up doses are not required if patients received them in their youth, and older eligible patients can be immunized at any period.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/82386a3d-f105-4e42-a150-a9f5cf0e9cbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Measles' symptoms include high fever, watery eyes, runny nose and rashes, which can be minor or full-body. Symptoms can become serious and even fatal, especially among children and those who are unvaccinated. One in five unvaccinated people who are infected are hospitalized, according to the National Foundation for Infectious Diseases.

Part of what makes measles so infectious is the virus' ability to stay active long after a patient has left, as the virus can stay active for up to two hours in the air and on surfaces, according to the World Health Organization.

Anton said the outbreak has especially affected the large Mennonite community in Gaines County. While the Mennonite Church does not forbid or disavow vaccinations, Anton said their communities tend to be undervaccinated, which drastically increases the likelihood of infection. Measles has a 90% infection rate among unvaccinated people who are exposed to the virus, according to WHO.

Alongside the decrease in vaccination numbers, Texas lawmakers have introduced [over 20 bills](https://substack.com/redirect/04b59201-3dc1-4a52-9a7c-1d5c926e03c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) into the Legislature aimed at loosening vaccine requirements across the state with the support of vaccine-hesitant or anti-vaccine groups." TOP NEWS "West Texas measles outbreak climbs to 58, with four saying they were vaccinated, " Texas Tribune'sAyden Runnels -- "An outbreak of measles in West Texas has grown to 58 cases, including four patients who said they were vaccinated against the disease. Ten more cases were added to the Department of State Health Services' count Tuesday, including for the first time the four who self-reported they were vaccinated against the disease, according to the agency's . A spokesperson with DSHS said health investigators are in the process of confirming whether the four were, in fact, vaccinated against measles and how many doses they may have received. DSHS of two cases of measles in underage children in Gaines County in late January. The disease has since spread to four other counties and 58 people -- most of whom are children -- but 45 of the cases are still in Gaines County. Lubbock County, which reported a single case, is the largest county in which a case was reported. Thirteen patients have been hospitalized, according to DSHS, and spokesperson Lara Anton said officials are still unsure what the initial source of exposure was. The outbreak is Texas' largest in more than 30 years, and comes at a time where vaccination rates among children . Almost 97% of Texas kindergarteners were vaccinated against measles in 2019, compared to 94.3% in 2024, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Despite the increase in infections among those potentially vaccinated, a DSHS spokesperson said virologists do not currently see "any evidence" the measles virus present in the patients has mutated into a vaccine-resistant variant. The measles, mumps and rubella vaccine, commonly referred to as the MMR vaccine, is about 93% effective with one dose and 97% effective with two doses, according to the CDC. The first dose is usually administered to infants aged 12 to 15 months, while the second dose is given to kids between 4 and 6. Follow-up doses are not required if patients received them in their youth, and older eligible patients can be immunized at any period. Measles' symptoms include high fever, watery eyes, runny nose and rashes, which can be minor or full-body. Symptoms can become serious and even fatal, especially among children and those who are unvaccinated. One in five unvaccinated people who are infected are hospitalized, according to the National Foundation for Infectious Diseases. Part of what makes measles so infectious is the virus' ability to stay active long after a patient has left, as the virus can stay active for up to two hours in the air and on surfaces, according to the World Health Organization. Anton said the outbreak has especially affected the large Mennonite community in Gaines County. While the Mennonite Church does not forbid or disavow vaccinations, Anton said their communities tend to be undervaccinated, which drastically increases the likelihood of infection. Measles has a 90% infection rate among unvaccinated people who are exposed to the virus, according to WHO. Alongside the decrease in vaccination numbers, Texas lawmakers have introduced into the Legislature aimed at loosening vaccine requirements across the state with the support of vaccine-hesitant or anti-vaccine groups." name: Rashida Tlaib
subject: These future candidates are ready to fight back
body:
It’s not too late to change course and elect future leaders who represent the needs of working people. | | |
---
Friend, Everyday people are looking for ways to fight back against this tyrannical administration. **One way to fight back is by supporting progressive candidates who want our government to work for the people, not for billionaires.** Right now, we’re in the midst of training our largest-ever cohort of future candidates for local and state office. We created our Rooted in Community Campaign School to train working people from diverse backgrounds how to run for office. Because it can be expensive to run an electoral campaign and difficult to do while working, many people who decide to run are wealthy. Most of my colleagues in Congress are millionaires, which means they don’t understand the urgent needs of our communities. So we run free training programs for regular people who want to be public servants so they can give back to their communities. Among this winter’s cohort of future candidates, 67% are women and 53% are Black, 21% are white, 10.5% are Arab, 10.5% are Asian, and 5% are Hispanic. So far, we’ve held sessions on running a campaign based on progressive values, how to file the necessary paperwork to run for office, fundraising and campaign finance, issue-based messaging and communications, and ending state violence and investing in communities. Our next session will cover field programs and working with volunteers to contact voters. clean_body: It’s not too late to change course and elect future leaders who represent the needs of working people. | | | Friend, Everyday people are looking for ways to fight back against this tyrannical administration. One way to fight back is by supporting progressive candidates who want our government to work for the people, not for billionaires. Right now, we’re in the midst of training our largest-ever cohort of future candidates for local and state office. We created our Rooted in Community Campaign School to train working people from diverse backgrounds how to run for office. Because it can be expensive to run an electoral campaign and difficult to do while working, many people who decide to run are wealthy. Most of my colleagues in Congress are millionaires, which means they don’t understand the urgent needs of our communities. So we run free training programs for regular people who want to be public servants so they can give back to their communities. Among this winter’s cohort of future candidates, 67% are women and 53% are Black, 21% are white, 10.5% are Arab, 10.5% are Asian, and 5% are Hispanic. So far, we’ve held sessions on running a campaign based on progressive values, how to file the necessary paperwork to run for office, fundraising and campaign finance, issue-based messaging and communications, and ending state violence and investing in communities. Our next session will cover field programs and working with volunteers to contact voters. At this moment when we’re seeing an authoritarian president tear our Constitution to shreds, I am energized and encouraged to see a powerful group of working-class candidates ready to run for office and take our government back. name: Tobias Read
subject: Laser-focused on delivering for the people of Oregon
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250219em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250219em]
Hi folks, it’s Tobias Read.
I am honored to be serving Oregon as Secretary of State.
To be tasked with defending our democracy is an immense and awe-inspiring responsibility. My obligation is to protect the democracy that has upheld the tenets of this country for centuries.
I do not take that responsibility lightly – especially now.
While Donald Trump and his allies in the White House try to attack our democracy on the national level, states still have enormous power to block their efforts and defend democracy.
This role has never been more critical. I am grateful for your support in helping me get elected to begin the important business of administering free and fair elections.
Unfortunately, it’s not as simple as just “doing the job”— getting good people elected is also part of it.
I want to raise $5,000 this month to help other candidates committed to defending our democracy and fend off efforts to roll back Oregon’s system of elections. And every hour I spend calling donors to ask for a contribution is an hour I’m not doing the critical work of being your Secretary of State. So I’m hoping you can help me out:
Will you pitch in $20 or more so I can stay laser-focused on delivering for the people of Oregon? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250219em]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250219em]
Thank you for your help.
Tobias Read
P.S. Don’t forget! The Oregon Political Tax Credit allows you to donate $50 (if you file single) or $100 (if you file joint) to a candidate, PAC, or party, which will be fully credited back as a rebate — so it’s free to donate! For more information, click here. [https://www.oregon.gov/omd/ONG/Documents/SMFS/Personal%20Financial%20Counselor/Political-Tax-Credit.pdf?]

Friends,
The world is shifting rapidly, and with it, the need for clear thinking, strategic action, and an unwavering sense of purpose has never been greater. This Substack is back, not to chase headlines or offer quick takes, but to provide something deeper: a way of seeing, understanding, and navigating the world as it is--and as it could be.
Instead of giving you a fixed schedule of upcoming topics, I want to share **the framework that guides my thinking.** Because at a time when reactionary chaos is pulling people in all directions, we need something stronger than outrage or exhaustion. We need **principles that hold, clarity that cuts through the noise, and an approach that allows us to build while others are consumed by distraction.**
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3260111&post_id=157516537&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTU3NTE2NTM3LCJpYXQiOjE3NDAwMTg0NjMsImV4cCI6MTc0MjYxMDQ2MywiaXNzIjoicHViLTMyNjAxMTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.-dkxmkG40O8ri4oGTvh9JYKCZL2at3OXnJp7yrj26ac)
## **The Five Forces That Shape My Thinking**
Everything I write here will be shaped by these forces:
### **1\. Patterns of Power (Historical echoes & what they mean today)**
History doesn't repeat, but it does rhyme. The authoritarian tactics we're seeing now--the purges, the concentration of power, the ideological crackdowns--are not new. Understanding **what has worked in resistance and resilience before** gives us essential tools for the present.
### **2\. Practical Resilience (How we endure & build alternatives)**
We need systems that don't collapse under pressure. That includes everything from **community-based economic models** to **food and energy security,** to the mental and emotional resilience required to outlast turbulent times. Survival isn't the goal. Thriving is.
### **3\. Narrative Battles (Shaping the stories that define the future)**
Power is built and maintained through _story_. The dominant forces in society right now are working to rewrite the past, control the present, and define the future. We cannot cede the narrative space. **We have to tell better, truer, more compelling stories.**
### **4\. Human Connection & Meaning (Because no movement survives without it)**
The greatest danger in chaotic times is isolation. Whether in politics, community-building, or personal resilience, the key to survival is **relationship.** What does it mean to build trust, reciprocity, and networks of care in an era of division and distrust?
### **5\. Governance & Systems Change (Because reform is not enough)**
The current systems are failing because they were never designed for justice, sustainability, or human flourishing. We must do more than resist bad policy. **We must create, test, and implement the new models that make the old ones obsolete.**
## **How I Choose What to Write About**
I don't chase headlines--I look for patterns, deeper shifts, and what will **actually** matter in the long run. Some topics will be deeply political. Others will go beyond politics into **how we build, sustain, and live with integrity in an era of upheaval.**
Expect a mix of:
* **Deep dives into systemic forces** (political, economic, environmental, social).
* **Historical analysis that illuminates the present.**
* **Practical strategies for resilience and impact.**
* **Reflections on meaning, purpose, and long-term change.**
* **Occasional personal updates** on the balance of family, work, and activism.

## **How You Can Engage & Be Part of the Work**
1. **Read, reflect, and respond.** Comment, share, bring your thoughts and perspectives.
2. **Show up in real life.** If you want to hear me speak, ask questions, and be part of deeper conversations, I'll be at **MAPS (Muslim Association of Puget Sound) on February 22nd** at the AMAC Banquet with Mehdi Hasan. [Join us](https://substack.com/redirect/c2c4e5b3-75c1-4428-a0c7-c9c921bda0f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). (Childcare provided!)
3. **Tell me what you 're working on.** If you're building something aligned with these principles, let's connect. You can always reach out to me through this platform, and I'm opening the comments to all subscribers.

The next post will be a deep dive into **what patriotism looks like in 2025.**
If this speaks to you, stick around. We have work to do.
-- Melissa

In an era of upheaval, understanding the forces that shape our world is essential. Here's the framework guiding our journey toward resilience, justice, and meaningful change. | | | Feb 20 | | | | | | | | | | | | Friends, The world is shifting rapidly, and with it, the need for clear thinking, strategic action, and an unwavering sense of purpose has never been greater. This Substack is back, not to chase headlines or offer quick takes, but to provide something deeper: a way of seeing, understanding, and navigating the world as it is--and as it could be. Instead of giving you a fixed schedule of upcoming topics, I want to share the framework that guides my thinking. Because at a time when reactionary chaos is pulling people in all directions, we need something stronger than outrage or exhaustion. We need principles that hold, clarity that cuts through the noise, and an approach that allows us to build while others are consumed by distraction. The Five Forces That Shape My Thinking Everything I write here will be shaped by these forces: 1\. Patterns of Power (Historical echoes & what they mean today) History doesn't repeat, but it does rhyme. The authoritarian tactics we're seeing now--the purges, the concentration of power, the ideological crackdowns--are not new. Understanding what has worked in resistance and resilience before gives us essential tools for the present. 2\. Practical Resilience (How we endure & build alternatives) We need systems that don't collapse under pressure. That includes everything from community-based economic models to food and energy security, to the mental and emotional resilience required to outlast turbulent times. Survival isn't the goal. Thriving is. 3\. Narrative Battles (Shaping the stories that define the future) Power is built and maintained through story. The dominant forces in society right now are working to rewrite the past, control the present, and define the future. We cannot cede the narrative space. We have to tell better, truer, more compelling stories. 4\. Human Connection & Meaning (Because no movement survives without it) The greatest danger in chaotic times is isolation. Whether in politics, community-building, or personal resilience, the key to survival is relationship. What does it mean to build trust, reciprocity, and networks of care in an era of division and distrust? 5\. Governance & Systems Change (Because reform is not enough) The current systems are failing because they were never designed for justice, sustainability, or human flourishing. We must do more than resist bad policy. We must create, test, and implement the new models that make the old ones obsolete. How I Choose What to Write About I don't chase headlines--I look for patterns, deeper shifts, and what will actually matter in the long run. Some topics will be deeply political. Others will go beyond politics into how we build, sustain, and live with integrity in an era of upheaval. Expect a mix of: Deep dives into systemic forces (political, economic, environmental, social). Historical analysis that illuminates the present. Practical strategies for resilience and impact. Reflections on meaning, purpose, and long-term change. Occasional personal updates on the balance of family, work, and activism. How You Can Engage & Be Part of the Work 1. Read, reflect, and respond. Comment, share, bring your thoughts and perspectives. 2. Show up in real life. If you want to hear me speak, ask questions, and be part of deeper conversations, I'll be at MAPS (Muslim Association of Puget Sound) on February 22nd at the AMAC Banquet with Mehdi Hasan. . (Childcare provided!) 3. Tell me what you 're working on. If you're building something aligned with these principles, let's connect. You can always reach out to me through this platform, and I'm opening the comments to all subscribers. The next post will be a deep dive into what patriotism looks like in 2025.** If this speaks to you, stick around. We have work to do. -- Melissa "It's a Matter of Integrity" by Melissa Chaudhry is a reader-supported publication. name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: What is our purpose?
body:
Reason and speech are gifts from God that enable us to think about God and to worship Him.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zeka6bm2f88l5sd9nq8bsfv5obt4ke5u8sf129cg_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1gm9oj2clh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I hope your day is going well. I’m writing to let you know about something I think you’ll find useful in your learning. Reason and speech are gifts from God that enable us to think about God and to worship Him. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6apueko55qpv7uus70uqboqu9rkeg2hf0sj7vpg_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1gm9oj2clh2bs) One of the chief aims of education at Hillsdale College is to understand what kind of being we are, as well as our purpose. That, in turn, makes it possible to begin to understand our relationship to God.

The study of God, also known as “theology,” has had a profound impact on Western civilization, stretching back thousands of years to the ancient Hebrews. And that’s what Hillsdale’s **“Theology 101”** online course is about—the development of theology from the Old Testament through the twentieth century.

**“Theology 101”** has been a popular course, so I’m pleased to let you know that it is [**now available for you to own on DVD**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zscs1k1uo48enuia4j817mj0lbspdvegq48amn3g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1gm9oj2clh2bs). You can add it to your home library or give it as a gift to a friend or relative.

We do have a limited number of sets in stock, though—and they go fast—so don’t delay in getting your copy of **“Theology 101”** on DVD. Secure yours right now at: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/support-hillsdales-online-courses-theology-101-dvd](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvahua3h5s17gieq69miumt353qss52vl4lm6pa0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1gm9oj2clh2bs)** Best regards,

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D.

Hillsdale College

In Your Solar Go-Fridge** Your Solar Go-Fridge can take any kind of frozen supplies with you. And when we say _any kind of supplies_ , we mean it. It has a small footprint, but has spacious capacity. **You get 42 quarts of space** for your critical items – that's like 46 cans or bottles of water. And no bulky ice bags!

"We all have lots of coolers. But this is a cooler extraordinaire. Not only is it a cooler, it's a fully-functioning refrigerator. It's great for me being a fisherman and an outdoor guy. I can put a bunch of fish in here and set it at freezing temperatures. And when I get home, my fish will stay frozen and I don't need any ice. It's a great tool. It's absolutely a must for campers and fisherman. It looks like a cooler, but it's actually a refrigerator which makes it a really special thing." Lisa W. "You don't have to stop and get ice anymore. That was one thing I hated to do early in the morning when we had to leave to go out of town to play in a baseball tournament. We had to leave at 5 or 6 or sometimes 4:30 in the morning and had to stop to get ice for our cooler. So this is nice because you just have to set it on refrigerator mode and you get your cold drinks or whatever you put in your cooler. People are already taking pictures with it, trying to find out more information so they could get their own." Lou H. "Please get one or two of them like I did. Peter, I know what it means to fight for something bigger than myself.

**I refuse.**

I work for you – not the Swamp, not the Establishment, and not the lobbyists. But that means I need your help. Fighting back against the D.C. machine isn’t easy, and the forces working against us have unlimited resources.

Peter, I’m turning to you today because this fight isn’t one I can win alone. Many Patriots, maybe even yourself, have been with me since day one, and I know I can count on you to help me plot the course.

[**Can I count on you to rush in a donation today and stand with me? Every dollar fuels this America First movement and pushes back against the corrupt D.C. establishment.**](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)

name: Newt Gingrich
subject: You did it in 1994. Can you do it again?
body:
This is a message for you

| | | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a2E5/?__vbtrk=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend, I’ve seen this battle before and I’m a little weary.

In 1994, the Republican Party made history.

We took on the Clinton machine, defied the media, and delivered a **once-in-a-generation** conservative victory, winning the House for the first time in 40 years.

We did it because we had a bold, conservative vision and the courage to **_fight, fight, fight_**** __**for it.

After decades of mismanagement from the Left, the Republican party had to come in and clean up the mess... _Just like what we’re seeing today._
Now, 30 years later, I believe I am seeing an even greater triumph, and an even greater mandate from the American people.

President Trump is cutting through the disaster and restoring America back to her former glory.
**_[But make no mistake: if we lose the House, we will lose control of America’s future](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a2E5/?__vbtrk=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)._**
[ACT NOW – DEFEND THE HOUSE](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a2E5/?__vbtrk=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
The Democrats have a calculated strategy to take back power:
* Outspend Republicans in key battleground districts.
* Deploy their media allies to rewrite history and attack conservatives.
* Mobilize far-left activists to push their radical agenda on YOUR community.

**__[We cannot let them succeed](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a2E5/?__vbtrk=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_._**
The Radical Left we are facing today isn’t so unlike the leftists we defeated when I was leading the House.
Only now, **they don’t even try to hide the vicious agenda they want to use to fundamentally transform our nation.**
[ACT NOW – DEFEND OUR COUNTRY](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a2E5/?__vbtrk=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Friend, we won in 1994 because we had leaders who stood firm and voters who showed up. With your support, we’re going to do it again.

Now, we must hold the line.

President Trump has managed to conduct one of the **most productive weeks in Presidential history**.
And, I can tell you as someone that’s been in the game for a long time, he’s been able to do it because **the House of Representatives has had his back every step of the way**.
If we don’t keep it that way, the Left will do everything they can to derail his agenda... maybe for good.
**__[Can we count on you](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a2E5/?__vbtrk=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc2MzczOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_?_**
_Yours Sincerely,_
Newt GingrichFormer Speaker of the House

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1962, [astronaut John Glenn](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71uwyAQAOCngS3WcRj_DAyRKm_p1p_NAt85psIhwjiR375q97zAJ31fl_HiQgy367tb2ZY5jQhoToAnhJFciMdYS7IzM7KWbFVbAxhlsJeLJTK90x48IINrEJ1SvlVmNr2fekIZ7J8GiKCU7mpdNRN1mprJT9B36EnUwBRKytVPCrey8ByP9OBcTWmV0S6l3DehzwIHgcOR9rJXngUOeAb49E81fH8IPczsyp5Z6LdtcZlJZkv3Z4gxbE0rariuLsR_srwqPiz-BgAA__8mb1H4) became the first American to orbit the Earth aboard Project Mercury's Friendship 7 spacecraft, which circled the globe three times in a flight lasting 4 hours, 55 minutes, and 23 seconds. ## Major Cuts Ordered in Defense Spending
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth ordered senior military officials to draft a five-year budget plan [cutting defense spending](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1u7CAUhJ_G7o4FB_xXUNzG3d42pYXhYJOwxgK8zr59tCulTDPFjDT69H3c5pv2we_rf30nVVyckWELDAHZbLUPz1nWVjkiJFGT4r1krOUtjvWmzLhIMQ6sG7hoe5ToRsedM53jstc91V693hgi41wMUjSdsYOwnVkMGwdcbCUZWV9iaj6j38tGLjzjg1Jj4r0OaivlyJX4V-FU4XRdV5PoLJTya381MQVb4XTmd0CI8SvDAJYc7ZlgOe1KBcxZgLTZYKfvAi08SacMl86b39cSdzhiLpDoiKlk-BXAxwqnOil7XD4En7u-kmy9ax_edOUvWw-FPwEAAP__4QlsaA) by 8% annually, according to an unreleased memo, calling for proposals by Feb. 24. Hegseth directed officials to assess needs based on a "wartime tempo" and eliminate spending on diversity, equity, and inclusion programs, as well as climate change studies.

Overall, an 8% annual cut over the next five years could [reduce military spending](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOnDAQhJ_GdEbLAgcULtLQXdqUyNhr7MjYJ7wc4u0j0v_taPTN6PvzXt46xJC233onxS4vCNhLQImwWB3ivXSVVY4Iqa1INUMH0Dc9TpVXvR1sh63RzpGFXvej0Q12erU9umkwVVAPDRChadqxa-uXsWNrX2Y1MI24WtEB2cD5qP_mkNiTi3f-0lGbvFdReeZPEe0vgbPA-bqueg8xsD5uDjuVpyVwTnQVgfOHEustJ2ly2g4qT_bMC5wBBc7N9DB8YJI-n4Uk3VSkTunUUY7SnCw5S0uOUiG5nnYjluyPfG5eIrQgcK4OZT9XiDGU1yA62HYd4v-z_JO8r8J_AQAA__8x3nHT) by nearly $300 billion. The memo also outlined 17 categories that the Trump administration classified as exempt. Those categories included operations at the southern U.S. border, modernization of nuclear weapons and missile defense, and acquisition of submarines, one-way attack drones, and other munitions.
## Trump Limits Independent Federal Agencies
President Trump signed an executive order Tuesday [expanding White House oversight of independent federal agencies](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00Ltu7CAUheGnwR2j7W18oaA4Dd2cNqXFwMZDhMEC5vb2kdOnXtKnpf_rul5NiCFt_81Oqvm8IuDIATnC6kyIn1V0TnkipKEj1c8CYOxHlN1dGT8tXhoP80QSxCxJkFzG4SYHAVKILqhTA0To-2ERw2WybhncZG8W5II3xwSQCy2Xy3cOqd3Jx09-UrnYvHdR3Vs7Khv-MdQMdfocubZzYqhPmKEGZKh7yVA_Kk_0qgx1K4_94DVsqXJ6k3208CSei6PCW-b0Pkxy3ObUSo48ex6So4OSo9S42SjZQKfTFeWOV4gx1GlmArbdhPj7rP1V6qnwJwAA__9g6Wrr), including the FTC, FCC, SEC, and the Federal Reserve's bank supervision role. The order applies to the Fed's regulatory functions, such as its oversight of big banks, requiring alignment with administration priorities, but [explicitly excludes its rate-setting role](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L2O6yAQxfGnsbuxYPAHLihu4y633dLCMARWGCJ7kihvv_L22__109H5uq03m3Iq9_92J8OhrihwAIGAYvU25c_at94EIiTVkpFTL8QgB5zbaIZ5UNrbadMSJ-c2HALOwdMotJdOuzaZSxOIQkqle9WNzmvlR7c5MWvcfNML8onr0X3XVDhSyJ_6oqNzdW-zicyPs1H_GlwaXEIqtjjqPjbWehUNLoXeZ4MLR4J3TEwQ6_Mk4HSPTOUEVwsfNcOFwlUF8gDbk6FUhlrgsEwnSC21nHs1d5H33B7GP94p53SOU9OL-25T_p3Ef130MvgTAAD__-3RacA) and other monetary policy decisions. The order, titled _Ensuring Accountability for All Agencies_ , requires these agencies to submit draft regulations, performance standards, and budgets for White House review to better align their actions with administration goals. Trump framed the move as necessary for accountability, but critics warn it could undermine the agencies' independence and faces likely legal challenges. ## Ford F-150 Dethroned as U.S. Top Seller
Toyota's RAV4 surpassed the Ford F-150 as [America's best-selling](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL3O3CAQRZ8Gd2PhAf9sQbFR5O5LuSktFoY1CTYWsLY2Tx-RPtWMdKWje8_Pr-VL--D31w-9kSouLsixB46AfLHah88iG6scEZJoSHWj5Lzverw1q5J6GEeyWvdTp1E_-XRDR4Jb57SeJDVeVRpH5F0nJinawdhJ2ME8Db9N-LRMcrK-xNT-in4vK7nwiSel1sStCWot5chM3BnODOfrutot7zVjONMO78xw1u8S6y3pbX7Xx8VkwUHXcwgxU4biSyCIDko8IFOoc-Gk1ZtA4CsGSoQSP7FoSPqUlZrgfu_-0GweTMzReMvE92_VE135QelokrLH5UPweRiZ5K9N-_CvdvmfxlPh3wAAAP__6QR2Hw) vehicle in 2024, ending 42 years of dominance for the iconic Ford pickup truck. Consumer data revealed that F-150 sales dropped by 5% to 460,915 units in 2024, while RAV4 sales rose by 9% to 475,193 units, making the Toyota crossover compact SUV the narrow leader in U.S. sales. Factors such as high interest rates, increased popularity of leasing, and a temporary halt in F-150 production due to supplier issues last year [may have contributed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uxCAQBp_G7rCWNfinoEhz3aVNaWFYn4m42xMQI7995PSpv08z0nzdl7sNMbwen_ZJpmy8IKAWgAJh8TbEc1GtNxsRUt-SkaMC0FLj3O5Gr0pKrVept9nZUQ7zMPl1lNRLDQ5cG8xFA0SQsp9U3w3OT70f3OpgnnD1jQLyoXDqvjm8yk5bPPmg1Dl-ttHspbxz0380eGvwVmvtqk0-25_C16PB20F7cJHyNe-n2Dh5sQmpQUTORWQbKQuXuL5EYVH45GJFsodqk_HvGmIMeRgbBY-nDfFPW_7LcBj8DQAA__8gsF_a) to the unprecedented decline in Ford truck sales. name: History Facts

body:
Gerald Ford will forever be in the history books as the 38th president of the United States, but he first entered the record books under a different name.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68dp3k764us9i7yeppczcbahs2m08vg7nr9yqzzvt60wjxg8yom2tk5u0wv07l5ow92brujl6ayuvmtqcum7ohuhx3whut70tp8ingjkokfrzdj9tofo2g9pnwnh19aey149wlhvmojqrepbv&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srzdkp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# [Gerald Ford was the first president to change his full name.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srzdkp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srzdkp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srzdkp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| G erald Ford will forever be in the history books as the 38th president of the United States, but he first entered the record books under a different name. He was born [Leslie Lynch King Jr.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srzdkp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), making him the first president to completely change his name. He did so for a good reason: Ford’s father abused his mother, Dorothy Ayer Gardner, and even threatened to murder her and her infant son after Ford was born. Gardner separated from her husband a mere 16 days after her son’s birth, fleeing first to her sister’s home in Oak Park, Illinois, before settling with her parents in Grand Rapids, Michigan.
---
Gardner married Gerald Rudolph Ford shortly before her son’s fourth birthday, and it wasn’t until he turned 13 that he found out Gerald wasn’t his biological father. Though he was never technically adopted, Ford [formally changed his name](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srzdkp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) to Gerald Rudolph Ford Jr. when he was 22. William Jefferson Blythe — better known as Bill Clinton — similarly changed his name at the age of 15, though in his case he took his stepfather's surname and kept his own first name.

## Ford didn’t have a vice president for the first four months of his presidency.
Gerald Ford took the oath of office on August 9, 1974, immediately following the resignation of President Richard Nixon amid the Watergate scandal. After [considering](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srzdkp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) Donald Rumsfeld and George H.W. Bush for the position of vice president, he nominated Nelson Rockefeller to be his VP on August 20. Rockefeller — the former governor of New York and a high-profile member of the ultra-wealthy Rockefeller family — accepted the position, despite claiming he was “just not built for standby equipment.” After a confirmation process that revealed financial information he probably would have preferred to keep secret, Rockefeller was confirmed by Congress on December 19, roughly four months after Ford took office. Rockefeller opted not to serve as Ford’s running mate in the 1976 election, claiming he “didn’t come down [to Washington] to get caught up in party squabbles, which only make it more difficult for the president in a very difficult time,” and was replaced by Bob Dole. Ford later said that not keeping Rockefeller was one of his biggest mistakes.

Kentucky Fried Chicken is moving its corporate headquarters from Louisville, Kentucky, to Plano. Parent company Yum! Brands announced Tuesday that about 100 corporate employees would be moving to North Texas over the next six months.

# Thursday, February 20, 2025
---|---
**Good morning!** On this day in 1874, Republican [Walter Moses Burton](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0zzFuwyAUgOHTwGYLPyDYA0MXb-na0XqY5xgVQwQ0Tm5fpXsv8H_6v67LFUMM6faJB9n23PICAnQnoAOxeAzxtSjurRN-GjjZwSghtJZy4rtFLZx2IwwroFzHDVZvJo8rjWoT2hEP9h0TAGIAOcqhR2_MpFCaTV7AKMOUIB9aLn3bqdET6xZf-UGlX_PBo91bu1cmPxjMDObzPPtWd8wphkR9LjcG847Ju5y_GcyUWglUGczup7ScuhNjo9IduVLlxfr7GWIM9fJ2bweG-Me0f78fFn4DAAD__4p8XBE) was seated in the Texas Senate after his Democrat opponent contested the election. Before serving in the Legislature, Burton was elected sheriff of Fort Bend County, becoming the first black person in the U.S. to hold that post. ## Texas Supreme Court Hears Winter Storm Uri Case
The Texas Supreme Court [heard arguments yesterday](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOszAQBOCngc5oWZs4FC7-hi5_eyVa8DqxZDCynTh5-xPprx99M5qf23wjH_x-_08bm_J2cUbAQQAKhNmSD59ZtdYsYMe-ZdNrBTAMUo7tw7jBDrSwXFWvwWlFdF0AtFxGBQrc2HpzYoAIPcqr7DuyWo-KpHbyglrpRgFbX2LqyoMLvym78IkvTt0atzaYRylHbuS_BqcGp1pr5-Jb0zMXv5-RBqeda25wQsBeVL8XTiKXmDbx5UR-Hok3Fmt8piKOWDmJNW4H7Z5zm4w9qg_B58u55b6RD9_q8ucXL4O_AQAA__9iCWJt) in a class-action lawsuit against electric utility providers accused of gross negligence during Winter Storm Uri in February 2021. During that storm, nearly 250 Texans died, and more than 4.5 million lost power, some for as many as four days. Over 30,000 plaintiffs are seeking billions in damages from energy companies. While courts have dismissed claims against natural gas suppliers, power generation companies, and electric grid operator ERCOT, lawsuits against distribution companies have been [allowed to proceed](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAUAL8Gb1j4PWzsgaELW7p2tAg8J0gQIiB2_PdVuvcH7k73c1kvNsTwuH3bRLq9t7yCgJEL4CBWb0M8V9l5fRV-GTrSg5JCjCPi0t31cHXbMim1TLNdEGZCIFQO5ehnunrsgv7ABIAYAGcceuuVWqRFteEESiomBfnQcunbnRq9bd3imXcqvcupi_re2rMy_GJgGJjjOPr2dvlVWu1veWdg6utZKBED42wlXl8p2RKoMjAguZAgeXjwQjw_XC6cIjnuKYadysldZmC6ov3zCDGGOn16bsmG-Kdv__7YNfwGAAD__3AeYfk). Energy companies have [paid lawyers up to $470 million](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FugzAQgOGnsbeg8_mI8eChHZA6pEOXjuiCTXyVKQgsmrx9le59gP-T_s_LcGEp8n175zmFep-WAQHbE-AJYYgs5TGQjuEK0RudgnEE0LbWep3DhJ0HZKbx6j2TJ05kyEDL3AHTqCU8MUAEg7azpuHonCe2brJndOQUQYpSl62pOdV0530qj-VIWzMusy4h17ruyr4o7BX2vI1ZjtSsWWE_v369fegtxPVHSpH9_MRuM0v5a-u_M0fA3wAAAP__QKZKhA) to avoid massive civil liability claims, and attorneys for the distributors asked the justices to dismiss their case Wednesday. They argued that they were following orders from ERCOT to reduce the load on the grid. Attorneys for the plaintiffs, on the other hand, argued that the providers cut power in a haphazard manner and neglected to prioritize natural gas suppliers, exacerbating the power generation deficit. In many cases, instead of implementing rolling blackouts, they cut power to certain neighborhoods for multiple days. A decision from the court is expected in the [next few months](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGu4yAQheGnwR3WMOAQFxTbuLvbbmlNzBCj4BABjpO3XyX9rY_069P59zP_UEzxfv1LG7v2CnlGwEECSoTZU0zv2XTeXcCPqmOnrAEYBq3HbnX2ZAJoxaQDBDUYfx5GPKM2GsiOVnXRfWKACAr1WauevLWjIW2DPqE1VhhgH1sufVu58YtqSO_85NIveeuSW1t7VKH_CJwETsdx9LR7Wt6fWeB0K8kLnO58VIFTbdRY4PTtyLo_Cm8sl7yXJluWK1OR-b7kIheqLEMuEgGVvCRabnlvtSvOP46YUqynD-26UUxfSfv1mqfD_wEAAP__Pf5l3w).

[](https://links.e.uso.)
**[SUPPORT SERVICE MEMBERS NOW](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/V7YEHrk~~ETw/M2t2QkFzYXpxQXMvM01qSmFwYXFiRDNIbTIwSDlVMkFzUnIwbjZkNnNZVjhwOE1VbWZXSjA0eGhrc2pmbHJVRTFwTVlJTXQ5eDFKYTk0QzRhczI0WGg2VUg2SnZLdTNoQ0owN25ySkxzYlU9S0/TnhJcDZrZkVzYkErV1JVR1MrMGJzWjBnNlhDR0IwZjRFL2U1VDJUbzBzcVJyZHpUS0FqOWd5Z2w5S1dlbWdZdDlKOVBTL0JPRThWRGVRSlFadXZMZ0VyT3ZoVUI2M2xKS0)**

name: Lila Rose, Live Action
subject: These diaper brands are pro-abortion
body:
Did you know that America’s most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

| [ ](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2ztklpri9c5mo0r1vu9jo9vmsqhqnuvlrdbqricio_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jm2ob2cdh2bs)
---
#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide. **
[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z023p1b18cobon8tvq3ee2s7fvg0qi3ga3ep1d3g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jm2ob2cdh2bs)
Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zaksehh91cor0gub3uukvoq1lur9up5hii41f0k0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jm2ob2cdh2bs)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There's only a few hours to go and we haven't been able to reach our goal of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider **[donating right now before this opportunity expires.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z9mta32f6ivfu0c36tmaqgmh4al0a4ct25e9hflo_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jm2ob2cdh2bs)**

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zk59bk5e4r9v7k0a3p8dk2qd3c16desnfl5l64e0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jm2ob2cdh2bs)

name: David Horowitz
subject: National Survey on Ending Government Unions
body:
Today, I’m asking you to complete this NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS.

| | | ...the deep-state
---
| |
---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative, **[Today, I’m asking you to complete this NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z4v7bu50643diq0pb6kvcadlg5aq8icm9b2583f0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)**
---
| | I’d be willing to bet you’ve never heard of Everett Kelly before.He’s not a member of Congress. He’s not a governor.He doesn’t hold elected office of any kind.And that’s the problem.
---
| [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z7ui909kbvl0l3lcudka0j669iisauvtca7q42pg_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)
---
| | Everett Kelly sits atop the American Federation of Government Employees – the largest government union with dues collected from 800,000 workers – who are fighting tooth and nail to defend the “crown jewel” of the radical left......the deep-state. And, before President Trump even takes office, Everett Kelly and the other proponents of “unionized government” are making the rounds in the media attacking President Trump, attacking Elon Musk, attacking Vivek Ramaswamy, and conspiring with the outgoing Biden administration to extend collective bargaining agreements (an attempt to tie President trump’s hands on this issue for the next two years). **[**That is why the results of this NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS will be tabulated and delivered to the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE).**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zn5p852ch5o93ig2rj1omgcphotsd87m5nu2ja1o_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)** Your participation is of the utmost importance.
---
* _Do you believe it’s acceptable that only 6% of federal employees show up in person for a full work week. And if you remove security guards, janitors, facilities and maintenance personnel, the number drops to 1%._
* _Did you know that in addition to 15 cabinet departments, there are over 2,000 federal agencies?_
* _Were you aware that leasing and maintenance costs for federal office buildings costs $15.7 billion per year?_
* _Or that the occupancy of these buildings is 12% on average?_
* _What about the fact that it’s nearly impossible to fire a federal employee?_

---
These are the questions on part one of the **[**NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zi7du51hm96qtdlthf36h3a5rjeaouks6rsj192g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)** And if you think these questions are infuriating, just wait until you hear what makes up part two of the survey. You see, part two is concerned with the actions of those government employees who actually do show up for work, but who spend every hour of the day plotting to undermine the will of duly elected presidents and ignore duly passed legislation.In other words, the radical deep-state. These are the bureaucrats who’ve burrowed deep into the federal government (often they served as political appointees in a leftwing administration, but refuse to leave after that administration ends, becoming, instead, career “civil servant”).CIA. FBI. National Security Council. State Department. Pentagon. Hostile agents at the highest levels of these departments spent four years leaking, lying, and unleashing lawfare against the first Trump Administration.
---
* _Shouldn’t the people we elect to run the government actually run the government?_
* _Shouldn’t members of the executive branch work in good faith to advance the vision and policies of the head of the executive branch?_
* _Shouldn’t any bureaucrat who can’t respect the U.S. Constitution leave government service?_
* _Shouldn’t it be an enormous “red flag” that Kamala Harris won 93% of the vote in Washington DC and the fact that roughly 95% of campaign contributions by government bureaucrats go to Democrats?_

---
You and I both know that the Constitution of the United States grants no power to unelected federal bureaucrats. Yet these individuals have enormous power and zero accountability.It’s bad enough you and I are being ripped off financially (covered in part one of your survey).But what’s worse is the reality that our votes and our constitutional republic are being ripped off and wholly undermined by these unions (part two of you survey). In short, this is an attack on the very foundations of our country. It’s part of the Marxist playbook that is destroying America... one that I’m intimately familiar with... because I helped to write and execute it when I was a member of the radical Left movement in the 1960’s and 1970’s.I know from first-hand experience how Marxist radicals sought to infiltrate every facet of American life... _Schools. Churches. The military. Unions. Businesses. The media. Hollywood. _And, yes, the federal bureaucracy.Now, I’m working to expose the TRUTH about the radical Left to a new generation that is being fooled. At the Freedom Center we use the Left’s tactics against them – tactics like those outlined in Saul Alinsky’s “Rules for Radicals” ... in other words we fight fire with fire. Today, I’m asking you to join the Freedom Center in exposing the threat posed by government unions to the mandate delivered by American voters in the 2024 election. **[**Your NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS is the key to reaffirming this mandate by demonstrating the consensus that exists to remove the obstructionist deep-state.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z3f07t5fiegde9qu4acuvl64k2aqilu9f784i8r0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)** Please complete it as soon as possible. There’s no time to lose.The Freedom Center is spearheading this movement. It is vitally important that we circulate 1 million of these surveys, so there can be no doubt where our country stands on this issue.Because if the threat of government unions is not broken, banned, and outlawed over the next two years... then it _never_ will. As I mentioned, the results of this survey will be reported to Elon Musk, Vivek Ramaswamy, and the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) whose charter expires on July 4, 2026 – on our nation’s 250th birthday. You see, we’ve got a very tight deadline to accomplish this mission. **[That’s why I’m asking you to complete your NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS without delay.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zv43nuplt34elh1j8nufbt7f2hnhtmvgdfe4k2e0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)** And that’s why **I’m also asking you to make a one-time contribution of $35** when you do. It’s going to take an enormous grassroots effort to circulate, collect, and tabulate the results of these surveys to the Department of Government Efficiency.**That said, if you can send a larger contribution – $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000, or more – it will supercharge this campaign.** I want you to know that the Freedom Center will maximize every dollar you contribute. We’ve had “woke” corporations and financial institutions conspire to “de-bank” and “de-platform” us before:
---
* They got MasterCard to shut off our online fundraising and credit card processing (we got it turned back on).
* We had to find a new bank after the local bank we’ve been at for years suddenly closed our accounts.
* The hotel we’ve held our annual fundraising conference at for the last 20 years abruptly declined to renew our contract.

---
You see, because of our effectiveness in fighting for conservative principles, they hate us. Like President Trump, we’ve faced countless lies, leaks, and lawfare attempts from the Left. But I refuse to back down.Especially against the wasteful, constitution-subverting unions that make up the federal deep-state. So please hurry. With your support today, I’m confident we can win this fight.
---
Sincerely,
---
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z6mj5dmb8hprd1pk9vc8c5lf4up81qumq5p3jj40_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)
---
| | **David Horowitz**
---
P.S. At the start of my email, I mentioned Everett Kelly and the 800,000 members of the American Federation of Government Employees union. According to their website: “** _On average, AFGE members pay between $18 - $22 per pay period for union dues_**.” **[**Your survey and your financial support are of the utmost importance in this fight to overcome the illegal, ill-gotten influence of these government unions.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zqmsutkokhi4fld4v4ptl22dq5vblhgt39o30t6g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)**
---

subject: Diaper companies are paying for abortions
body:
Did you know that America’s most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

| [ ](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zndue0566isumgn8nad3u1uj5im4e3d9ikf59e18_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide. **
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3at9ecj81da9vo5i5onqm3h43ddbkrtt9broo4g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)
Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf71vovncihvcl3jvdvk5qemffqar6su8rn9c8l0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There's only a few hours to go and we haven't been able to reach our goal of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider **[donating right now before this opportunity expires.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl2pcpabcn78v94rdgdbokc3pgvndgm0a15pbr28_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)**

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcvm5in2ugrj7eucutfo2fp28onvqj8p0llorseo_rp22sh2s8i6eob0c1jmapj0cjh2bs)

**This week, news broke that The Washington Post backed out of a signed agreement to run a $115,000 ad calling on Trump to fire Elon Musk.**
The ad, funded by Common Cause and the Southern Poverty Law Center Action Fund, was set to wrap around the front and back pages of the Tuesday edition—distributed to Congress, the Pentagon, and the White House.
The newspaper had even provided the groups with sample artwork to guide their design. And what was the sample? A recently published pro-Trump ad praising Trump’s promise to roll back electric vehicle mandates.
Yet, just days before publication, the Post abruptly pulled the ad without explanation.

# Trump signs executive order ending all tax-funded benefits for illegal aliens
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/83658774-7916-4836-b6a1-74332556138d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
President Donald Trump signed an executive order Wednesday evening banning all taxpayer-funded benefits for illegal immigrants, targeting welfare, health care and housing assistance.
The move, announced at a White House briefing, aims to redirect resources to American citizens and legal residents.
"My Administration will uphold the rule of law, defend against the waste of hard-earned taxpayer resources, and protect benefits for American citizens in need, including individuals with disabilities and veterans," the executive order read.
The Department of Homeland Security will oversee compliance, verifying immigration status for benefit applicants.
Data from the Census Bureau shows roughly 11 million undocumented immigrants live in the U.S., with many relying on public assistance through citizen relatives.

| | Why do some people stay sharp as a whip as they get older, while others have trouble recalling names, dates, and even conversations?

New research from Harvard University suggests age may not be the culprit.

And one Boston medical doctor now says memory problems are often caused by the foods you're eating — or NOT eating.

Dr. George Karanastasis, MD says: _"Your brain needs fuel to create new brain cells, recall memories, and focus on tasks. And where does it get that fuel? From the foods you eat."_

However, due to a change in modern dietary habits, Dr. K says most of us aren't getting the nutrients our brain needs. He says this lack of nutrients can cause brain fog, forgetfulness, or worse.

_"When your brain doesn't receive the right nutrients, it literally starts to starve. And that's when you start to suffer those embarrassing senior moments. You might forget people's names, walk into a room and forget why you're there, or even get lost driving to familiar places,"_ Dr. K says.

Fortunately, Dr. K developed a simple protocol that can help fight memory loss.

Best of all, it doesn't require any major lifestyle changes. It just requires adding [**these 3 foods back into your diet**](https://link.myamericanpatriot.).

Dr. K recently put together a video revealing these foods. And since the video was released, it's gone viral, racking up more than 1 million views. Thousands of folks around the country are singing the praises of this protocol.

He says: _"I've seen this protocol work for thousands of people. People keep telling me: 'Dr. K, I feel so much sharper and smarter. Even my family noticed.' It's wonderful to hear how many lives this has changed."_

Now, what about you? Are you concerned about your fading memory? How would you like to take back control of your life?

February 20, 2025
A [recent op-ed](https://substack.com/redirect/cc21ad4c-915c-43ae-8177-adcc0588dc07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the digital version of the Hartford Courant entitled "Ten arguments for accountability in Connecticut" by Ms. Christine Palm criticizes Connecticut Republicans for supporting President Trump while listing ten talking points to "earnestly to engage with Republican friends, family members and colleagues" while pointing out their logical fallacies.
[Ms. Palm](https://substack.com/redirect/eba4d69e-e8aa-4b18-bb40-e6c5bb1ebb5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is a former State Democratic Assemblywoman who represented the towns of Chester, Essex, Deep River and Haddam from 2018 to 2024, the year she chose not to run for reelection.
She is 69 years old and married to the talented artist, [James Baker](https://substack.com/redirect/b7b40bf4-08ec-4651-a0c7-c4c13c2216cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They have four sons. She worked as a newspaper reporter, high school teacher, owned a bowling alley and was once nominated for a Pulitzer Prize.
She is a wonderful person and her opinion must be respected. But let's go over her ten points which I abbreviate for brevity and give the Republican response:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8f155a32-03db-4642-92a2-d31697f61180?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Ms. Christine Palm
1\. _Trump issued more than 20 executive orders on Day One, and not one member of the Connecticut GOP objected. These are the same people who freaked out when Gov. Lamont issued 26 executive orders, over the course of several months, in order to keep people safe during the worst public health crisis [COVID] since the Spanish Flu of 1918._
This would make sense if the Democrats did not "freak out" over Trump's executive orders. But anyone who has followed Democratic [Senator Chris Murphy's response](https://substack.com/redirect/ab1583a3-503c-4cd2-af2f-fd99dd0f0739?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is aware that this is not the case.
Furthermore, Republicans were accurate in criticizing Governor Lamont's executive orders as they did not lower the death rates from COVID in comparison to other states while having a devastating educational impact on children, especially minorities along with destroying many small businesses.
2\. _As ICE officers begin to cull through Connecticut towns looking for folks to deport, the GOP remains silent about the fact that Trump deliberately detonated the bipartisan compromise immigration deal Congress worked out._
This makes no sense. ICE officers are enforcing our immigration laws. The fact that Republicans refused to agree to a "bipartisan compromise immigration deal" is irrelevant. This "compromise immigration deal" - if passed - would not have made illegal immigrants legal.
3\. _Republicans have conveniently gone silent about "Backing the Blue" since Trump's pardon of the Jan. 6 rioters whose actions resulted in the injury of 140 U.S. Capitol and D.C. Municipal Police Officers and led to the deaths of five others. _
Here Ms. Palm has a significant point. President Trump should not have pardoned violent offenders in the Jan. 6 riots. But Ms. Palm fails to mention that an unarmed woman, Ashley Babbitt was [murdered Officer Michael Byrd](https://substack.com/redirect/18a41dbb-2364-49df-a895-92d7bf71c836?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Not only was Byrd not charged with this crime, but he was promoted and then retired with a generous pension. Perhaps President Trump believed these injustices cancelled out.
4\. _Connecticut GOP elected officials are not objecting to Trump 's description of the insurrectionists as "hostages." _
What Ms. Palm fails to mention is that many of the so-called insurrectionists who were imprisoned committed no violence or property damage but merely entered the Capitol building. But aggressive prosecutors coerced them into taking unfair plea deals rather than being bankrupted by high legal bills while risking the wrath of a Trump-hating Washington D.C. jury.
Furthermore, the FBI has now admitted that Confidential Information Sources (in other words "spies") attended this rally, a charge the FBI previously denied. Did some of these FBI-hires goad protestors into entering the Capitol? This is still being investigated.
5\. _As Trump threatens to abolish -- or severely limit -- the resources available to FEMA, Connecticut Republicans readily accept FEMA dollars to repair streets destroyed in last summer's climate change-induced floods._
President Trump has not abolished FEMA. Rather he has insisted that the money be used for natural disasters that affect American citizens, not used to house illegal immigrants as was being done in New York City.
6\. _How do they [the Republicans] explain the incompetence, lack of experience, and blatant conflicts of interest of Pete Hegseth, Robert Kennedy Jr. and Lee Zeldin, to name but a few of Trump 's most egregious cabinet choices?_
The President has the right to choose his cabinet. Time will tell whether they are competent or not. Furthermore, Ms. Palm fails to mention that the Democrats under President Biden voted to confirm this "woman" whose seafaring skills were not properly vetted.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fe041a4d-2b13-4f83-bbc3-c0c134e6ae2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Admiral Rachel Levine
7._Trump has tied federal highway funds to 1) our birth rate (aka pro-choice stance); our vaccine laws and mask protocols (which saved lives)._
Ms. Palm has a point. But she fails to mention that FEMA under the Biden administration bypassed houses in need during the North Carolina hurricane because they had Trump signs in their yard. Petty politics is a two-way street.
8\. _It seems likely that at least some of Connecticut 's GOP have a parent or grandparent who fought in WWII. If so, how do they think that forebear would feel about a person close to the president [Elon Musk] giving the Nazi salute? _
There is no patent on the "Nazi Salute." Otherwise, these people would be in trouble too.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/68399b4c-a622-43d3-8559-6573f5a00dc9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
9\. _Because our legal system rightly convicted Trump of numerous heinous acts, the GOP has abandoned its former stance that "law and order" -- must be respected at all costs. _
"Rightly convicted"? The cases against President Trump were of dubious legal validity:
FBI agents stormed his house carrying automatic weapons with orders to use "deadly force if necessary" and sorted through his wife's underwear looking for executive documents he arguably had the right to have.
A prosecutor in Georgia accused Trump of trying to find extra votes and then used the taxpayer money released to prosecute the case to hire her lover, go on lavish vacations and then perjured herself when she got caught.
A judge fined Trump for half a billion dollars for inflating the value of his real estate to banks to obtain loans even though the banks did not lose a nickel from non-payment.
A woman E. Jean Carroll was awarded a $100,000,000 judgment by accusing Trump of sexual assault even though there was not a scintilla of evidence the event occurred. Carroll even posed on the cover of New York Magazine with the jacket she claimed she was wearing when Trump assaulted her. The problem was that the jacket was manufactured after the date she claimed to have been assualted. When Trump's lawyer wanted to present this exculpatory evidence to the jury, the Trump-hating judge threated to imprison the lawyer.
10\. _And finally, it would be helpful to know if, like Trump, Connecticut 's GOP caucus members will blame the nearest female, brown, Black, trans, non-binary, or disabled person or Armed Forces member the next time a helicopter crashes into an airplane._
Ms. Palm has a point here. Trump appears to have jumped the gun with this accusation. But a strange thing has happened since. There has been no significant refutation of Trump's statement.
One of the three helicopter pilots was a woman, and her name was not released until days after the event and after all information about her was scrubbed from social media. And outrage from Black and gay congressmen has been decidedly muted. Perhaps they are more concerned that the air traffic controllers at Reagan Airport are qualified rather than DEI (Diversity. Equity and Inclusion) hires, since they fly into Reagan regularly.
Furthermore, the plane that flipped over while landing at a Toronto airport (fortunately none of the 80 passengers were killed) had [an all-female crew](https://substack.com/redirect/eebbccaa-e2d1-44ba-bd7b-b7866c201347?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Where these women properly qualified or were they DEI hires? Would Ms. Palm board a plane with DEI pilots to show solidarity with the feminist movement?
The Democratic Party can roar back by supporting Medicare for All, increased taxes on the superrich, stronger private sector unions, replacing 401K's with defined-pension plans and the repealing of zoning laws that keep minorities in poor school systems.
Fortunately for us Republicans, Ms. Palm and her party are ignoring these issues.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
It’s budget season in Washington, Derek. Here’s what’s going on:
Last week, House Republicans released their budget resolution — a blueprint for enacting the Trump-Musk-Project 2025 agenda — and voted on party lines to advance it out of the House Budget Committee.
Its next stop will be a full vote in the House, and if it’s passed there, it’ll come to the Senate. So let’s talk about what’s in this budget:
* Massive cuts to Medicaid, Medicare, and SNAP.
* Head Start programs being shut down.
* Community health clinics being shut down.
* Reduced staff for veterans’ hospitals and clinics.
STAND AGAINST THE GOP BUDGET [https://secure.ngpvan.com/jtypJL4MKE-ZlYF9yB4mig2]
The advertised purposes of this resolution are border security and defense. But this is a trojan horse. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/jtypJL4MKE-ZlYF9yB4mig2]
I know that because we always pass bipartisan defense funding bills. And we had a bipartisan border security bill last year that Trump forced Republicans to abandon. So this budget bill is not needed to address defense or border funding.
Inside the trojan horse, we see clearly that this budget is an effort to dramatically cut support for programs that help everyday Virginians and everyday Americans so that those funds can be directed into tax cuts for the wealthy.
The dollars “saved” by cutting critical services like food stamps and Medicaid — combined with the tariffs that Trump is laying on American families that will make their lives more expensive — will go into a big pot that gets used to fund tax cuts for the rich.
4.5 trillion dollars of tax cuts.
I will fight this — I’ll offer amendments, I’ll try to protect Medicaid and other safety net programs, and I’ll work to get the bottom of what this budget would actually do to working people in our country.
But right now, let’s just be candid about what’s going on here: This is an effort to amass savings off the backs of everyday people, combine it with tariff revenue, and direct all that money into tax cuts for the wealthiest Americans.
Republicans can’t just trick people while agencies are being shut down left and right and programs that everyday people rely on are being ruthlessly cut — we see right through it, and we won’t stand by and let it happen.
If you agree that we need a budget that will actually help people, not hurt their lives and livelihoods, add your name to my petition to demand a common-sense budget that keeps critical safety net programs intact. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/jtypJL4MKE-ZlYF9yB4mig2]
Thanks for reading and for speaking up.
-Tim Kaine
