Friend - "Ranked choice" voting is a popular tool in the push to make the voting process more democratic and enable citizens to have a greater voice when they go to the polls.
If you’ve never heard of it, the explanation is simple : the voter gets to rank the candidates in the order they prefer them, instead of just picking one. This helps empower a diverse slate of candidates and also acknowledges that, if your first choice didn’t win, you’d certainly prefer a second candidate who more closely resembles your beliefs rather than having the other main party win by default.
The use of ranked choice voting is still being discussed, including states like Alaska, where an effort is underway to get rid of it.

ACROSS THE COMMONWEALTH
VOTE TODAY! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Make%20A%20Plan%20To%20Vote.png]
You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/VWCC.jpeg] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC
Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.
LOCAL CANDIDATE EVENTS
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/lily%20canvass.png]
Canvass for Lily Franklin!
On Sundays, join Team Lily at the South County Library Parking Lot from 12 - 12:30 pm for a Roanoke canvassing event!
Bring your walking shoes, a charged cell phone, and water. When you arrive to their launch location you will receive a brief training and literature before being sent out to turf. Questions? Email Beth at egunter3@gmail.com [egunter3@gmail.com] or call 540-353-3645.
South County Library Parking Lot, 6303 Merriman Rd, Roanoke, VA 24018

Join us Sunday to canvass for Sam and Trish! Meet our Field Coordinator, Dom, on September 3rd at the Williamson Road Library, 12:00pm.
Located at 3837 Williamson Rd, Roanoke, VA 24012.

Without current regulations, the water contamination caused by these companies could have been so much worse. Come out to support Roanoke Valley Democratic candidates!
Read More [https://roanoke.com/news/local/source-of-forever-chemical-in-roanoke-river-to-pay-1-billion-settlement/article_da6f7bca-598f-11ee-881b-8bac139e59c4.html?fbclid=IwAR1qjW8zAjGrPndXAdQUujaypWNYnxc5JZCyD7FVTO7RJLbp9BBceVPyfq4#tracking-source=home-top-story] The Roanoke Young Democrats will be enjoying pizza, coffee, donuts and more before canvassing to knock for Trish White-Boyd, Sam Rasoul, Lily Franklin, Samantha Newell, Jade Harris, & Nancy Horn. Door knocking will begin about 12:30 pm!
Read More [https://www.facebook.com/events/275519338709424]
Roanoke EnVision Center Kids Movie Night - Sept. 28 Fall Harvest Festival
The movie is free and there will be snacks and much more! Fall into wellness at the Harvest Festival!
Read More Celebrate the end of farm season with fun experiences for the whole family. Try new activities to support your well-being. Connect with others in a beautiful outdoor space. Free meals available with registration. This event is free and open to everyone!

https://www.facebook.com/events/3583390115210992 [https://www.facebook.com/events/3583390115210992] https://roanokehiddenhistories.org/ [https://roanokehiddenhistories.org/]
Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

Roanoke City Democratic Committee meetings are now in-person and open to non-members. We meet the 3rd Thursday of each month. This month we are meeting at 6 pm at the Main Library (706 S Jefferson St, Roanoke, VA 24016). Sign up for meeting reminders and other information here [https://www.roanokedemocrats.com/subscribe] .
Join us for a social hour every first Thursday of the month at Leonore Restaurant, 128 Campbell St. SW, 5-7 pm.
Join Roanoke Young Dems! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/RYD.png]
Meetings occur on the first Monday and third Sunday of every month in person and virtually. The goal of RYD is to help improve our community and to promote the names of Democratic candidates and policies.
Contact: YoungDemocratsRoanoke@gmail.com [YoungDemocratsRoanoke@gmail.com] to get involved!
Donate Today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/samrasoul]
Thank you for your support! If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to me anytime.
My very best,

body:
The loss will be beyond what you can imagine...
| | | [](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20388/6374453/46efa7a5cea4dd2ec055f2517ec2f057e47aa569/50427eba06487061d10458574a08d569ca7e4e19)

_February 20th, 2025_
---
| | |
---
**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis**
---
---
**This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_“Food shortages are coming.”_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life – depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

**Well, no need to worry anymore.** Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by some companies. That's why I ordered and got my very own stockpile of these best-selling [**Survival Food Kits**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20388/6374453/826d6ee4862fde1176643a26aaf62d6ecb5dcd8d/50427eba06487061d10458574a08d569ca7e4e19). When you secure your own food stockpile, you will have the peace of mind and security knowing that when a crisis hits... You will be able to calmly reassure your family that they're safe and they will have plenty to eat. [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20388/6374453/826d6ee4862fde1176643a26aaf62d6ecb5dcd8d/50427eba06487061d10458574a08d569ca7e4e19) When a crisis hits, the masses begin to panic, and grocery stores are wiped out. It quickly becomes every man for himself. Don't make the mistake of waiting until it is too late. [**Stock up now**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20388/6374453/826d6ee4862fde1176643a26aaf62d6ecb5dcd8d/50427eba06487061d10458574a08d569ca7e4e19) on these survival food kits while you can. **More Raving Customer Reviews!** **Rory H.**
"I was surprised to find that the densely packed packages were easy to prepare and were tasty as well. I definitely recommend having survival food on hand for the times when 'life' happens while we are planning other things." **Billy H.**
"Received my food kit, and I was able to make the potato soup on my cookstove. Just needed boiling water. Gave it a good stir and let it simmer. When I opened up the pot, it smelled so good. You can see the chunks of potatoes and carrots in each bite you take. It's a good soup." **Kevin S.**
"The 72 hour kit is a perfect starter kit for any scenario. Put one in your car, work bag, in your house or RV. If you want to start preparing safe food, this is where to start." **Carol B.**
"I have been iced in this weekend. I thought I would try my potato soup. To my utter delight, IT WAS DELICIOUS. Thank you for such a wonderful product and the peace of mind it brings." **Ken K.**
"I am not a full-blown survivalist. I am not an idiot, either. I have been through enough in my life and have seen friends who have been through an emergency situation. Save up if you have to, but get at least a month's supply. It tastes good. Although if it's a dire of an emergency, you will be happy to eat anything. IF you have something to eat for your family. We made some of this product, and had family and friends over for them to taste. They all agreed they didn't think anything would be this good, and they will be ordering. Just do something. You can't miss out on this deal." **Justin A.**
"My wife and I tried the food and we were both surprised about how good it tasted and how satisfied it made us feel afterwards. It feels good knowing that I can provide for my family if a crisis arose and I intend to get more in the future. Also the shipping and customer service has been top notch. This is probably the cheapest survival food I have found, and the company is great." **Gary M.**
"I actually had lost my job and was homeless for a while. I dug into my food supply, and I cannot fully describe how delicious and easy to prepare everything is. I felt like I was eating like a king. I am going to stock up again as soon as I settle into my new job. Everyone should participate with this company. You will not be disappointed." **John H.**
"We're in Florida and have made many preparations for the aftermath of a possible hurricane. While we are thankful that Florida has not been hit in several years, it gives us great peace of mind to know we have our 4Patriots kit stashed away, knowing it's not a case of "if" but "when"." [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20388/6374453/826d6ee4862fde1176643a26aaf62d6ecb5dcd8d/50427eba06487061d10458574a08d569ca7e4e19)

Mike Braun announced on Wednesday that Braun recently signed an executive order surrounding Medicaid costs for Applied Behavior Analysis, or ABA, therapy. According to a news release from Braun’s office, the order establishes a group that would explore the containment of the cost for the therapy while maintaining the quality of care for Hoosier children and young adults. ABA is a therapy for the early treatment of autism. Officials said that from 2017 to 2019, state Medicaid payments for ABA increased from $14.4 million to $120 million. Over the next year, Braun’s office said that payments are expected to increase even more, with $645 million projected to be spent for around 8,000 children in 2026.

* Potential caps on the number of months a child can recieve therapy
* Creating an appeals process for extenuating circumstances
* Establishing new provider enrollment and billing requirements for ABA providers to address issues identified in the audit.

You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025. #2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode. I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won't work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. As our special "Thank You" for becoming a Founding Supporter at the $50 level, we'll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk FREE on DVD.This exclusive Adventure with Iggy and Mr. Kirk DVD is only offered to Founding Supporters. It won't be available for sale anywhere. So with , you'll be part of a select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You'll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor's office. So many children have no way of hearing God's message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child's life. There's no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family -- not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a Founding Supporter of Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk. Sincerely, | | Kirk Cameron (and Iggy!)Actor, Author, and Father | | | Kirk Cameron (and Iggy!)Actor, Author, and Father | | | P.S. The #1 thing you can do today to stop the Hollywood groomers who are tearing families apart -- maybe even yours -- is to support the very first children's television show in history made possible by contributions from grandparents and seniors like you. Thank you and God bless you and your family! -- Kirk | | Brave Books 13618 Poplar Cir, Suite 302Conroe, TX 77304 | | Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. Let’s be real: there’s a lot of scary stuff in the headlines lately about the current status – and threats to – our American democracy. And while we’re throwing everything we’ve got into the resistance, we can’t forget about all the other critical issues that still deserve Congress’ attention.
For me, that includes common sense gun safety reform.
Earlier this month, I introduced legislation requiring gun stores to better secure their inventory after-hours. This will help crack down on smash-and-grab robberies, where stolen guns are often used in subsequent crimes.
The bill is nearly identical to bipartisan legislation passed at the county and state levels under my leadership. I was pleased to have the support of both law enforcement and gun safety groups then, just as I am now.
I could use your help reaching out to more grassroots organizations that can get this bill across the finish line. Will you contribute whatever you can today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/joc-2025?refcode=1.3]
I appreciate your support as we work to keep stolen guns off our streets.

| | **Last Saturday, I hosted a telephone town hall.** Thank you to all those who joined me, and took the time to call, email, and rally outside my office in response to the chaos of this current administration. **I hear you, I share your concern and frustration, and I am fighting back.** **Since February 3rd, we have received 3,172 calls.** On top of that, we have also received 17,359 messages, mostly through email from you. There is a clear sign of concern and frustration from all of you, and that is why I hosted the town hall so I could communicate with you about what I am doing to fight back. **President Trump's Project 2025 is alive and well.** In his first month as President, he is sowing chaos and confusion by trying to implement an agenda that Courts have already said violates the Constitution and breaks promises to lower costs for families and businesses. The President promised to cut energy prices in half, but at the time of the town hall, gas prices in Everett were up 10% since Inauguration Day. The price of meat in the grocery store has gone up 2% just in the past month. **He is not focused on families and businesses, he is solely focused on his agenda.** **Trump and the GOP are working for the richest Americans and wealthiest corporations.** They are only changing the budget to help pay for a massive tax cut, but Democrats are fighting back with unity and purpose. **As the lead Democrat on the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, I have taken several actions to push back against this Republican Rip-Off:**
* I sent a letter to Secretary Duffy at the Transportation Department about the infrastructure freeze that is freezing dollars right now that otherwise would go to job-creating infrastructure investments
* I signed a letter to rebuke the late-night purge of Inspectors Generals, the folks in charge of rooting out corruption fraud in Government
* Earlier last week, I sent a letter to Secretary Duffy on the halt of the EV charging station program
* I have sent a letter to Trump and Officials about the illegal firing of four FEMA Officials in New York
* I am pushing Secretary Duffy to continue to implement the FAA Reauthorization Bill that will improve aviation safety

I am not sitting by as this administration continues to sow chaos and confusion, and neither should you. Call the White House - let them know that you disagree with this agenda, and make sure they know that we can not be sidelined. **Members of Congress and Congress as an institution do not have legal standing in Court to challenge Executive Orders.** But, Congress can and does partner with States' Attorney General like our own Attorney Nick Brown, to partner with nonprofit organizations and unions to challenge Administration actions. Right now, groups have filed more than 65 lawsuits related to at least 25 of the unlawful Executive Orders. **When we push back against this Republican Rip-Off, we win.** The public pressure is working, and I need you to continue to speak out when the Republican Rip-Off hurts you and your community. **You have a voice, and we want to hear from you.** More soon, _Rick_ | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution to Rick Larsen instantly:

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: I’m leading the effort to reverse Trump’s transgender military ban
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends,
You may know that I serve as Co-Chair of the Transgender Equality Task Force in the House, and I’m so proud to work with my colleagues to advance and protect trans rights. I also sit on the House Armed Services Committee, and represent San Diego, the largest military community in the country. As you may already know, there’s a big intersection of trans rights and the strength of our military.
In case you haven’t been following, here’s the background: On January 27, President Trump issued an executive order barring trans individuals from enlisting and serving openly in the military. On February 10, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth doubled down and issued a memo barring gender affirming care for service members.
In response, I led 41 of my House colleagues in an effort to reverse these dangerous and costly decisions.
Join my efforts by signing on to my petition today. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/878h4zovL02gBKuuRD6bjA2]
The ban is discriminatory and hateful, plain and simple.
But it’s about more than that – it’s also a matter of military readiness and national security.
Kicking thousands of trans service members out of our Armed Forces would undermine readiness and recruitment – and would take 20 years and billions of dollars to replace their lost expertise and talent.
Many trans service members have been serving openly for more than a decade, and 73% of trans service members are senior personnel who have extensive experience.
They are combat-ready. They’re deployed. And they’re fully fit for service in our meritocratic all-volunteer force.
Deeming these service members unfit solely because of their identity goes directly against our goal of having the strong military needed to keep our country safe.
If you’re with me on this issue, please add your name today to demand that Trump rescind Executive Order 14183 and allow our trans service members to continue serving their country. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/878h4zovL02gBKuuRD6bjA2]
Thanks for standing with me.
-Sara

clean_body: [] Friends, You may know that I serve as Co-Chair of the Transgender Equality Task Force in the House, and I’m so proud to work with my colleagues to advance and protect trans rights. I also sit on the House Armed Services Committee, and represent San Diego, the largest military community in the country. As you may already know, there’s a big intersection of trans rights and the strength of our military. In case you haven’t been following, here’s the background: On January 27, President Trump issued an executive order barring trans individuals from enlisting and serving openly in the military. On February 10, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth doubled down and issued a memo barring gender affirming care for service members. In response, I led 41 of my House colleagues in an effort to reverse these dangerous and costly decisions. Join my efforts by signing on to my petition today. [] The ban is discriminatory and hateful, plain and simple. But it’s about more than that – it’s also a matter of military readiness and national security. Kicking thousands of trans service members out of our Armed Forces would undermine readiness and recruitment – and would take 20 years and billions of dollars to replace their lost expertise and talent. Many trans service members have been serving openly for more than a decade, and 73% of trans service members are senior personnel who have extensive experience. They are combat-ready. They’re deployed. And they’re fully fit for service in our meritocratic all-volunteer force. Deeming these service members unfit solely because of their identity goes directly against our goal of having the strong military needed to keep our country safe. If you’re with me on this issue, please add your name today to demand that Trump rescind Executive Order 14183 and allow our trans service members to continue serving their country. [] Thanks for standing with me. -Sara [] Congresswoman Sara Jacobs California’s 51st District CONTRIBUTE [] [] Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress Sara Jacobs for Congress PO Box 120085 San Diego, CA 92112 United States www.facebook.com/SaraJacobsCA/ [www.facebook.com/SaraJacobsCA/] twitter.com/sarajacobsca [twitter.com/sarajacobsca] www.instagram.com/sarajacobsca/ [www.instagram.com/sarajacobsca/] CONTRIBUTE TODAY [] We believe these emails are a critical way for Sara to stay in touch with supporters and constituents. | | **Dear Friends,** We hope this message finds you well. **The New Pennsylvania Project** and **Why Courts Matter** **– PA** are excited to continue our crucial work of providing civic education to our communities. As a voting rights organization, our mission is to offer current, accurate, and accessible information on the importance of voting in every election. We would like to invite you to join us for our [**Why Courts Matter – 301 Virtual Town Hall**](https://u44255144.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.ekJ0nzuGxxKMd6ADw0n9YhVueAlOBMb0se9nBbj0OBKxWIYHr3D3kJ-2BAjmyFPsLuymF0mxxwaGghlOMuBCigl8O281r9tbscAcsxkWxIuGbCS72FkVTxAGUkQmgkuXbuiddH_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVAKmTIthZAqug-2BBe3TY9jweA5gYJTWBMeK2mbEu1GsUAWbMxqbbanoccXqIiueqpc6DIzHn4ElffI7A3Y14vKdCNksTNdqpcPsZ-2Fywu-2FMuXA4y3CGiU9X4tiAddJTMlizHBV3fCrFnIJPehcpV1HfrYhDH-2Fv-2B8MKyX-2FRs2ie98EbeFxiDZIy-2B7DT5kmMimqQbIuFO9AU5A48lRoYl3wTgWHACVNa-2Fs8W7YlpLNeY6-2B3fXWnRwTUcc6MYsIW-2Fh-2FDKaYtvo3Nah6gTQJ4Nkb3zNlLILQDsNDwelyiKQO5X5pPWgKQBk220nGFdD6iGbrEj94lF4fq5KS3KGU1dxY2Vx82). **Event Details:****Date:** Thursday, February 27, 2025
**Time:** 6:30 – 7:30 PM (via Zoom)
**Speakers:** Kadida Kenner, Founding CEO, New Pennsylvania Project and Quentin Mansfield, Democracy Project Coordinator, NPP This town hall will focus on the importance of our federal courts, their impact on our daily lives, and how we can advocate for the independence of our federal courts. During the event, we will discuss:How federal judges are appointed and confirmed for a lifetime.Cases heard by our federal district and federal appellate courts.How the federal courts impact our daily lives. Your participation can make a significant difference. A civically engaged electorate is crucial to ensuring fair and independent courts. **Please register below to attend** , and feel free to share this invitation with friends and family:

The New Pennsylvania Project and Why Courts Matter – PA are excited to continue our crucial work of providing civic education to our communities. As a voting rights organization, our mission is to offer current, accurate, and accessible information on the importance of voting in every election. We would like to invite you to join us for our . Event Details:Date: Thursday, February 27, 2025 Time: 6:30 – 7:30 PM (via Zoom) Speakers: Kadida Kenner, Founding CEO, New Pennsylvania Project and Quentin Mansfield, Democracy Project Coordinator, NPP This town hall will focus on the importance of our federal courts, their impact on our daily lives, and how we can advocate for the independence of our federal courts. During the event, we will discuss:How federal judges are appointed and confirmed for a lifetime.Cases heard by our federal district and federal appellate courts.How the federal courts impact our daily lives. Your participation can make a significant difference. A civically engaged electorate is crucial to ensuring fair and independent courts. Hostile agents at the highest levels of these departments spent four years leaking, lying, and unleashing lawfare against the first Trump Administration.

* _Shouldn’t members of the executive branch work in good faith to advance the vision and policies of the head of the executive branch?_
* _Shouldn’t any bureaucrat who can’t respect the U.S. Constitution leave government service?_
* _Shouldn’t it be an enormous “red flag” that Kamala Harris won 93% of the vote in Washington DC and the fact that roughly 95% of campaign contributions by government bureaucrats go to Democrats?_

Peter—

In an expected but nonetheless disgraceful decision, the Trump administration reinstated the Global Gag Rule late last month. This policy will deny individuals across the world access to essential sexual and reproductive health services and information.

**Here's what you need to know—and what comes next for repro rights advocates.** **What is the Global Gag Rule?** A policy originally introduced by the Reagan administration in 1984 that restricts U.S. funding assistance or grants to non-U.S. nongovernmental organizations (NGOs) providing, counseling, or advocating for legal abortion services. **Who does the Global Gag Rule affect?** Any organization that receives grants or assistance from the U.S. government is put in the difficult position of losing vital funds or accepting the funds but severely restricting their ability to provide and counsel on abortion care. **How is the Center for Reproductive Rights fighting back?** To help affected NGOs navigate this policy and retain as much funding as possible, the Center has created a **[Global Gag Rule Pro Bono Clearinghouse](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102463413/529265867/-788023469?sourceid=1150417&utm_campaign=25emcge-0202aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=ggr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDA1Y2FiNi1iNWVmLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QXiPE5JKlkRvzPi37flqaXZMcda7crUeck1lfT9DL9Q=&emci=65cdf8af-b5ef-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=c005cab6-b5ef-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=954237),** connecting NGOs with expert global law firms that can provide pro bono counsel. **What can I do? Where can I learn more?** Next, we stay united, informed, and prepared. Peter,

President Trump created a new federal agency, the so-called “Department of Government Efficiency” (DOGE), without Congressional approval. Even worse, he installed Elon Musk as its head, giving the richest man in the world sweeping, unchecked authority over the entire federal government.

Musk, who was never vetted or confirmed by the Senate, is using this unlawful power to cut the federal government to the bone. While I joined 18 other attorneys general in filing a lawsuit to block DOGE’s access to sensitive personal information, Musk still has the ability to wreak havoc on state and local governments, federal employees, and the American people.

By creating an agency out of thin air and appointing Musk without Congressional approval, President Trump blatantly violated the Appointments Clause of the Constitution.

I didn’t run for office so I could sue President Trump, but as Attorney General, it’s my job to hold him accountable if he oversteps his authority. That’s why I joined 13 other attorneys general in filing a lawsuit to stop this illegal power grab.

body:
It’s not too late to change course and elect future leaders who represent the needs of working people. | | |
---
Friend, Too many elected officials today lack the urgency of the moment. This is because many are millionaires who don’t understand the urgent needs of their constituents. **But it’s not too late to change course and elect future leaders who represent the needs of working people.** After November’s election, applications surged for this winter’s _free_ Rooted in Community Campaign School, where we train working-class candidates―with a focus on women and people of color―to run for office. # **So... Who's in Charge?**
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wijgp-v43rez-kyd76rh8/)
---
| | | | Dear friend, Donald Trump likes to pretend he’s a strong leader. But when it comes to **Elon Musk** , he’s nothing more than a puppet. At a White House press conference, **Trump was cut off, ignored, and overshadowed** —by the billionaire who poured **hundreds of millions** into his campaign. Even **Sean Hannity** dismissed Trump, eager to hear from Musk instead. And when it came time to speak, Musk didn’t just share the spotlight—he took over. **Trump was left hunching at the Resolute Desk, a silent spectator in his own presidency.**
The facts don’t lie: 📌 Musk spoke **50% more than Trump** at their joint press event. 📌 Trump’s own vice presidents—Pence and Vance—and other MAGA members would never dare to upstage him like this. 📌 Musk isn’t just an advisor—he’s a funder, a power broker, and now, a shadow president.
And it gets worse. Musk, an **unelected** billionaire with **zero accountability to the American people** , is now working from inside the White House to gut federal agencies, all while claiming he’s "restoring democracy." **Restoring democracy? Or buying control of it?** [**_So, who’s really running this country? The person who won the election? Or the billionaire who bought his way into power? America deserves answers. But one thing is already clear: Trump isn’t calling the shots—Musk is._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wijgp-v43rf0-kyd76rh5/) In Solidarity, The No Dem Left Behind Team

There’s a lot going on right now, but the bill that is expected to be heard on the floor in the House needs the full attention of anyone who cares about the future of our democracy.
Despite its name, the “Safeguard American Voter Eligibility” (SAVE) Act would do absolutely nothing to make our elections safer. Instead, it would put up barriers designed to prevent millions of eligible voters from casting their ballot.
It’s the culmination of constant lies about our elections, claiming rampant fraud without a shred of evidence — all to justify and pass a radical political agenda to restrict voting and weaken democracy as we know it.
**This is a pivotal moment for voting rights — and we cannot afford to stand idly by as a guiding principle of American government is dismantled.**

Because you’re a member of this grassroots team, I know you agree that our democracy works best when all of us have an equal say in the decisions that shape our future.
The SAVE Act is a direct effort to undo that ideal. It would require all eligible Americans to provide proof of citizenship by presenting documents like a passport or birth certificate when registering to vote. This would be on top of voter ID laws that a majority of states already have in place.
What’s more, the SAVE Act would:
* Upend online voter registration, a practice in 42 states;
* Make it impossible for Americans to register to vote by mail; and
* Put an end to many voter registration drives nationwide.

If passed, these changes would disproportionately impact military voters, rural voters, tribal citizens, survivors of natural disasters, working-class Americans, and the tens of millions of married women who have changed their names. About half of American citizens — nearly 150 million citizens — do not have a passport, and elderly Americans are one of the demographics least likely to have one.
**The SAVE Act is just the latest example of extreme, partisan efforts to make voting more difficult for citizens, all hidden behind a thin veil of disinformation and false claims of widespread voter fraud.**

clean_body: Rush a donation to All On The Line to protect voting rights and strengthen our democracy. | BREAKING: House Republicans are planning to vote on the SAVE Act — an extreme, anti-voter bill that would disenfranchise millions of eligible voters. = Hi Peter, There’s a lot going on right now, but the bill that is expected to be heard on the floor in the House needs the full attention of anyone who cares about the future of our democracy. Despite its name, the “Safeguard American Voter Eligibility” (SAVE) Act would do absolutely nothing to make our elections safer. Instead, it would put up barriers designed to prevent millions of eligible voters from casting their ballot. It’s the culmination of constant lies about our elections, claiming rampant fraud without a shred of evidence — all to justify and pass a radical political agenda to restrict voting and weaken democracy as we know it. This is a pivotal moment for voting rights — and we cannot afford to stand idly by as a guiding principle of American government is dismantled. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Because you’re a member of this grassroots team, I know you agree that our democracy works best when all of us have an equal say in the decisions that shape our future. The SAVE Act is a direct effort to undo that ideal. It would require all eligible Americans to provide proof of citizenship by presenting documents like a passport or birth certificate when registering to vote. This would be on top of voter ID laws that a majority of states already have in place. What’s more, the SAVE Act would: Upend online voter registration, a practice in 42 states; Make it impossible for Americans to register to vote by mail; and Put an end to many voter registration drives nationwide. If passed, these changes would disproportionately impact military voters, rural voters, tribal citizens, survivors of natural disasters, working-class Americans, and the tens of millions of married women who have changed their names. About half of American citizens — nearly 150 million citizens — do not have a passport, and elderly Americans are one of the demographics least likely to have one. The SAVE Act is just the latest example of extreme, partisan efforts to make voting more difficult for citizens, all hidden behind a thin veil of disinformation and false claims of widespread voter fraud. = All the best, Jacob Carrel Deputy Director of Policy = is the grassroots advocacy campaign supported by the National Redistricting Action Fund. It struck the suspect, who died instantly. James was shaken by the incident, but thankfully he was unhurt. He went home, certain he had done everything by the book. **So you can imagine our shock when James found out he was being charged with murder!** You see, James is white, and the suspect he shot was black. My husband is exactly the kind of man you want keeping your city safe. But none of that matters to radical prosecutors like Fani Willis. She knows what happened that night. She knows James was in a life-or-death situation. She knows that the charge should have been dropped years ago. Fanni Willis just wants to make an example out of my husband. For years, we've been trapped in limbo. We've lost nearly all our friends, and we've even been forced to move because of the terrible lies the prosecutors have been spreading about my husband. By some miracle, we've been able to get by, but every day is difficult. And what's been truly overwhelming is the cost of James' legal defense. Earlier this year, we ran out of money. We've lost nearly all our friends, and we've even been forced to move because of the terrible lies the prosecutors have been spreading about my husband. By some miracle, we've been able to get by, but every day is difficult. And what's been truly overwhelming is the cost of James' legal defense. Earlier this year, we ran out of money. We had all but given up hope... And then we got a call from Jason Johnson, the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund, or LELDF. If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongfully-accused police officers like James. Not only did the LELDF board decide to help my husband get the legal defense he deserves, they're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys so James can finally clear his name. That's why I'm writing to you today to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone... His legal team needs to be working day and night to get ready to defeat Fani Willis's team and get my husband declared NOT GUILTY once and for all. We have nowhere else to turn. And I'm so scared for what will happen to my husband. It's your that could make the difference between defeating Fani Willis and the radical anti-police prosecutors on her team -- and my husband spending the rest of his life in prison. Thank you for taking the time to read about my husband. And thank you in advance for helping my James. Sincerely, Jenna Burns P.S. My husband did EVERYTHING he needed to survive that night. He doesn't deserve to die in prison. But that's EXACTLY what will happen if radical prosecutor Fani Willis gets her way. Please help James before it's too late! Thank you for helping me save my husband and my family. | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit. And remember –Blue Lives Matter! © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | 2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303

| | Hi D. P., There are profound differences between a democracy and a constitutional republic that are crucial to every aspect of American life. Our founding fathers warned us and provided great insight to defend our constitutional republic with all our might. That is why the President of the United States takes an oath of office and recites "I do solemnly swear (or affirm) that I will faithfully execute the Office of President of the United States, and will to the best of my ability, preserve, protect and defend the Constitution of the United States." Other federal officials recite "I do solemnly swear (or affirm) that I will support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic". But the reality of 2025 is that the “we the people” could not even tell you how many Articles are found in the Constitution. It’s a small document with 4,543 words. It was written in 1787, ratified in 1788, and has been in operation since 1789. The United States Constitution is the world's longest surviving written charter of government. It’s first three words – “We The People” – affirm that the government of the United States exists to serve its citizens.

A democracy excludes the minority’s rights. Hamilton saw that in a democracy, the majority have the right to take away the rights of the minority simply by being the majority. Take present issues like gun rights or religious liberty. The majority has the ability to seize the rights of the minority because democracy does not balance power. Our founding fathers saw the horrific consequences of letting the majority have total power, so they instituted a system that ensured that everyone’s opinion mattered. But the reality of 2025 is that the average American citizen today would fail if we administered an American Test of the Constitution. Sincerely,Ingrid Centurion P.S. This week in Florida, a Jewish American named Mordechai Brafman fired 17 shots at two people, believing them to be Palestinian. He later openly confessed that he believed he had killed them. In reality, his bullets only grazed the two victims, a father and son duo. One victim suffered a grazed bullet wound to his left forearm while the other suffered a gunshot to his left shoulder. But this story has a bizarre twist. His victims were not Palestinians, not Arabs, and not Muslims--they were Israeli Jews, a father and son, the Rabeys. And sadly the story gets even worse from here.
Even after surviving an attack by a Jewish American gunman, Ari Rabey, one of the victims, took to Facebook to blame Arabs for the violence. He posted, _" Dear Jews, they tried to kill us for nationalistic reasons,"_ and falsely claimed the attack was "_anti-Semitic_." He even posted _" Death to the Arabs."_
And chances are this might be the first you heard about it. **Let 's Address This.**
**Wait a sec! Take a moment to join 118,000+ like-minded activists and subscribe below to Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid.**

Mordechai Brafman Miami-Dade County Corrections and Rehabilitation
### Where Is the National Outrage?
The official police affidavit states:
> It should be noted that while in custody in our interview room, the defendant [Mordechai Brafman] spontaneously stated that while he was driving his truck, he saw two Palestinians and shot and killed both.
Let's be clear about what happened: A Jewish American man nearly killed two Israeli Jews because he thought they were Palestinian Arab Muslims--and the victims instead still blamed Arabs for the attack, calling for their death. In other words, the victims didn't condemn the would be murderer for trying to murder them, because his intent is one they apparently agree with, i.e. "death to Arabs."
And the absurdity still does not stop here. Consider that this shooting happened in Florida, [a state that has charged a woman denied healthcare coverage with terrorism](https://substack.com/redirect/4cc3806f-047a-475e-b0f7-7fbd5702e27a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because she repeated, "_delay deny defend, you 're next_," to Blue Cross and Blue Shield. The woman, Briana Boston, is a mother of three, has no history of violence, doesn't even own a firearm--yet currently languishes in house arrest and faces up to 15 years in prison if convicted of terrorism.
Meanwhile, though Mordechai Brafman is being held in jail without bond, so far he has only been charged with two counts of second degree attempted murder--not terrorism, and not a hate crime. If convicted, he also faces up to 15 years in prison. How are empty words deserving of the same punishment as shooting at two people 17 times, hitting and nearly killing them? Why is it terrorism to verbally express non-violent frustration to a health insurance company, but not terrorism to fire 17 times in broad daylight with the intent to kill two people because you thought they were Palestinian Muslims?
Finally, imagine if the roles were reversed? In such a case, this would be headline news across the country. If a Palestinian had shot at two people mistakenly believing they were Jewish, the media would rightly be in an uproar, and politicians would rightly rush to condemn the act. But in this case, there has been no national outcry, no demand for justice, no hate crime charges filed against Brafman, and no mass political movement to ensure this injustice never happens again.
Why?
Does Brafman's incompetence in identifying his targets excuse his anti-Arab racism? Does the fact that his bullets grazed his victims, instead of killing them, somehow make his actions less of a hate crime? If someone fires 17 rounds at people based purely on ethnic hatred, how is that _not_ an act of terrorism?

### How You Can Help Demand Justice
Right now, The Miami State Attorney's Office of Hate Crimes under State Attorney Katherine Fernandez Rundle is considering whether or not to charge Brafman with a hate crime. You can raise your voice to demand justice. Here's how.
1. Please take a moment to call State Attorney Rundle's office at (305) 547-0100 to encourage them to file hate crime charges against Brafman.
2. Email Hate Crimes Division Chief Justin Funck at justinfunck@miamisao.com to encourage him to file hate crime charges against Brafman.

Here is a sample email to send:

Dear Attorney Funck,

I am writing to encourage you to file hate crime charges against Mordechai Brafman for his attempt to kill two Jewish people, while believing they were Palestinian Arab Muslims. Such hate, whether Islamophobic, Anti-Arab, or anti-Semitic, has no place in our country. It must be condemned with the strongest words and actions possible.

At a time of deep divisions in our country, it is critical that equal justice and accountability apply to those who engage in such horrific violence. We must bring down the rhetoric and hold accountable those who engage in such hate. Your leadership in ensuring such accountability will make this a safer and more prosperous nation for all people, regardless of background. Thank you.

Sincerely,

[Name]
This cycle of dehumanization, misinformation, and bigotry does not make Jewish Americans safer. It does not make Palestinian Americans safer. Indeed, it makes life worse and more dangerous for all people in this country. While fortunately no one was killed in this vile attack, we all have witnessed the horror of mass murder from mass shootings.
This is why we must stand united against all forms of hate--against antisemitism, Islamophobia, and anti-Arab bigotry alike. Justice must be equal, accountability must be equal, and violence rooted in hate must be condemned regardless of the identities of the perpetrator and victim. We must demand that Mordechai Brafman be held fully accountable under the law. Anything less sends a chilling message: that hate crimes against Arabs and Palestinians don't matter.
Call, email, share this post in your network, and encourage them to act. Let us raise our collective voices for justice, and reject this reckless, dehumanizing violence.
**Thank you for your trust and support. I am doing everything in my power to counter injustice. I cannot do it alone. Subscribe below and join the movement.**

And chances are this might be the first you heard about it. Let 's Address This. Wait a sec! Take a moment to join 118,000+ like-minded activists and subscribe below to Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid. | | ---|---|--- Mordechai Brafman Miami-Dade County Corrections and Rehabilitation Where Is the National Outrage? The official police affidavit states: It should be noted that while in custody in our interview room, the defendant [Mordechai Brafman] spontaneously stated that while he was driving his truck, he saw two Palestinians and shot and killed both. Let's be clear about what happened: A Jewish American man nearly killed two Israeli Jews because he thought they were Palestinian Arab Muslims--and the victims instead still blamed Arabs for the attack, calling for their death. In other words, the victims didn't condemn the would be murderer for trying to murder them, because his intent is one they apparently agree with, i.e. "death to Arabs." And the absurdity still does not stop here. Consider that this shooting happened in Florida, because she repeated, "delay deny defend, you 're next," to Blue Cross and Blue Shield. The woman, Briana Boston, is a mother of three, has no history of violence, doesn't even own a firearm--yet currently languishes in house arrest and faces up to 15 years in prison if convicted of terrorism. Meanwhile, though Mordechai Brafman is being held in jail without bond, so far he has only been charged with two counts of second degree attempted murder--not terrorism, and not a hate crime. If convicted, he also faces up to 15 years in prison. How are empty words deserving of the same punishment as shooting at two people 17 times, hitting and nearly killing them? Why is it terrorism to verbally express non-violent frustration to a health insurance company, but not terrorism to fire 17 times in broad daylight with the intent to kill two people because you thought they were Palestinian Muslims? Finally, imagine if the roles were reversed? In such a case, this would be headline news across the country. If a Palestinian had shot at two people mistakenly believing they were Jewish, the media would rightly be in an uproar, and politicians would rightly rush to condemn the act. But in this case, there has been no national outcry, no demand for justice, no hate crime charges filed against Brafman, and no mass political movement to ensure this injustice never happens again. Why? Does Brafman's incompetence in identifying his targets excuse his anti-Arab racism? Does the fact that his bullets grazed his victims, instead of killing them, somehow make his actions less of a hate crime? If someone fires 17 rounds at people based purely on ethnic hatred, how is that not an act of terrorism? How You Can Help Demand Justice Right now, The Miami State Attorney's Office of Hate Crimes under State Attorney Katherine Fernandez Rundle is considering whether or not to charge Brafman with a hate crime. You can raise your voice to demand justice. Here's how. 1. Please take a moment to call State Attorney Rundle's office at (305) 547-0100 to encourage them to file hate crime charges against Brafman. 2. Email Hate Crimes Division Chief Justin Funck at justinfunck@miamisao.com to encourage him to file hate crime charges against Brafman. Here is a sample email to send: Dear Attorney Funck, I am writing to encourage you to file hate crime charges against Mordechai Brafman for his attempt to kill two Jewish people, while believing they were Palestinian Arab Muslims. Such hate, whether Islamophobic, Anti-Arab, or anti-Semitic, has no place in our country. It must be condemned with the strongest words and actions possible. At a time of deep divisions in our country, it is critical that equal justice and accountability apply to those who engage in such horrific violence. We must bring down the rhetoric and hold accountable those who engage in such hate. Your leadership in ensuring such accountability will make this a safer and more prosperous nation for all people, regardless of background. Thank you. Sincerely, [Name] This cycle of dehumanization, misinformation, and bigotry does not make Jewish Americans safer. It does not make Palestinian Americans safer. Indeed, it makes life worse and more dangerous for all people in this country. While fortunately no one was killed in this vile attack, we all have witnessed the horror of mass murder from mass shootings. This is why we must stand united against all forms of hate--against antisemitism, Islamophobia, and anti-Arab bigotry alike. Justice must be equal, accountability must be equal, and violence rooted in hate must be condemned regardless of the identities of the perpetrator and victim. We must demand that Mordechai Brafman be held fully accountable under the law. Anything less sends a chilling message: that hate crimes against Arabs and Palestinians don't matter. Call, email, share this post in your network, and encourage them to act. Let us raise our collective voices for justice, and reject this reckless, dehumanizing violence. Recent polls indicate a decline in President Donald Trump's approval ratings during the initial month of his second term.
Greetings from Gay Valimont, running for FL-1. People are waking up to Trump’s horrid agenda, and now is the time, before special elections, to double down on our efforts!
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/782F7A556777367543426277794857357A765A494330393846482F6A695859716F6A42545443513571664C4A46724C4B645A6830486E6C674566436A6362476E/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-02-20%20at%201.59.07%E2%80%AFPM.png]
A CNN/SSRS poll reveals that his approval rating has dipped below 50%, with a significant portion of Americans expressing concern over his efforts to expand presidential powers. body:
The 2025 General Assembly Session
| | | | 2025 THE HONEY BADGER REPORT
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
---
| 2025 SESSION Friday What can you expect?
---
|
# AMANDA CHASE
---
|
# VIRGINIA'S HONEY BADGER
---
| Dear Hello Senators are still in session as I write to you. They are in a "Senate Recess." You can tune in [here](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001uHSjUpGaRzT2qVeuRizl0nKCdkBvP4lneb4pj7Gi8LlLkbDQ3plBvxPoZuM0xQCqktgduOsGcqOxO9R12KfWOjxcnEz-6C9zgxr1CQ1vg6SFW210pLmgKAdZvVfYogpO1tPtW7yvuloQ_GNW0Lj6nseVkMkFjj5st386oPzJfb3g0MMILdq4xkp-gh2gja2eaxOzkPhKmMXiLDY3yvTfyA==&c=uScETKx_GoRL56QKLa_ceo9oFDldfqDHbMuRN5nGXs2M0tTa148Q-A==&ch=mDDiO0jb6F3QV54fqi6sI8mbyR98QheOfuyxuG_sIWewrv-Lt_3tlA==). The Senators had one regular calendar plus 3 supplemental calendars to get through. Sounds like it's going to be a late night.
Many people have no idea the long hours legislators spend working on legislation for the 30 or 40 day Constitutional deadline they are given to complete their work. They work through all holidays and snow days. The only thing that has delayed them, was no running water at the beginning of session. Legislators have spent months living out of suitcases and temporary living quarters.
The last days of session are the longest. So be sure to thank your legislators for their service. State Senators receive an annual salary of approximately $18k, which is far less than what their staff get paid. If they live more than 20 miles from the Capitol they receive a small stipend while they are in session.
Even out of session, legislators still have constituent services, parades, business luncheons and speaking engagements. It's a life of sacrifice and service.
Some of you have been surprised that the General Assembly still meets during inclimate weather.
No matter how much snow or ice we receive here in the Commonwealth, the General Assembly still meets every week day until their work is complete.
State legislators must live in the district they represent. It's state law. As such, most live hours away and lodge locally in the Richmond area during session.

---
| |
---
While Friday is the last day of the work week for most people, the General Assembly will meet both tomorrow and again on Saturday.
That's right, Saturday.
I've included the links below for you to follow both video coverage of session and the Senate floor docket, also called a Senate calendar. So if you are off of work on Saturday and you want to watch your Virginia Senate in action, just tune in. The time has not been determined at this point but my best guess based on my 8 years in the Senate, is that it will probably start around 9am, Saturday morning. They have not adjourned as of 8pm, so the Senate has not announced an official begin time for tomorrow. I would tune in around 10am.

George Latimer is a lifelong Westchester resident who has built a career in public service by delivering unparalleled progressive results for local residents. Now, he's taking that work to the next level by serving as your Congressman, representing New York's 16th District. Peter, it’s George. One month ago, today, we witnessed the second inauguration of Donald Trump before he returned to the White House as President of the United States. Since then, Donald Trump and his Co-President Elon Musk have unleashed a wave of unconstitutional chaos over Washington and the entire country — the likes of which we’ve never seen before. Not only has he attacked the incredible progress we’ve made these past four years, but he’s systematically undermined our federal government by dismantling critical agencies, firing thousands of federal workers without cause, attempted to erase birthright citizenship, and completely ignored the rule of law every step of the way. We’ve got a message to this administration: **Following the Constitution isn’t a recommendation. It’s not optional. It’s the law of the land,_and they will be held accountable._** So far, the courts have already stepped up to halt these illegal overreaches — from temporarily blocking DOGE access to the confidential data of Americans at the Treasury to restraining their mass layoffs of federal employees. [Congressional Democrats and our allies are fighting tooth and nail against the dangerous efforts of the Trump-Musk administration — and I need to know that I have you by my side. Yesterday, Elissa joined Nicole Wallace on MSNBC for a conversation about the state of President Trump’s conversations with Putin, and the future of Ukraine.

Team —
Ever since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , far-right legislators have continued to attack reproductive rights. That’s why having leaders who stand up for our reproductive freedoms has never been more important, **and Jocelyn is that leader**.
As Secretary of State, she has been at the forefront of the fight to defend our rights. After voters in Michigan passed a constitutional amendment guaranteeing the right to reproductive health care, Jocelyn *fought back* against extremists who tried to overturn the will of Michiganders.
Unfortunately, the fight is just beginning.
From trying to take away IVF to banning safe and legal contraception, right-wing legislators and judges are working to turn back the clock on our progress every day.

Michigan has led the way in expanding reproductive rights — and with Jocelyn as Governor, she’s ready to continue that work.

name: Eve Schiff
subject: Yes, Adam and Eve
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
| I’ve been by Adam’s side through some incredibly serious moments.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=8318%2E5257348%2EER4tIZ)
Hi Derek, this is Eve Schiff, Adam’s wife.
Today is our wedding anniversary, and it’s unlike any we’ve celebrated — 3 decades together!
When we were first introduced, I’m not sure either of us would have predicted it was a match made in heaven... but we knew it was quite literally a match.
We first met on a tennis court in Los Angeles, where we played a mixed doubles game set up by a mutual friend.
Rest assured, I whooped him. But he didn’t care. He called me up at work the next week and asked me out to dinner.
Since then, we’ve played plenty of tennis matches (he’s improved his form since then but I still beat him).
And I’ve been by Adam’s side through some incredibly serious moments.
Did you know Adam lost his first two campaigns and didn’t win until we got married? That was surely a coincidence...
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/engagement-202502-marriage-advice?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_NOA_AC90_20250220_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=8318%2E5257348%2EER4tIZ)
In fact, during one of his campaigns, while we were recently engaged, a voter called to give us advice — not on the campaign, but on our getting married. He advised us to think hard about it, and said of his own marriage: “It’s no picnic.”
Well, every year as we celebrate our anniversary (did I mention **this is number 30!**), we take stock of what a good year it has been, then look at each other and remember “no picnic.” Never fails to make us crack up.
[SHARE YOUR MARRIAGE ADVICE](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-202502-marriage-advice.Zrn3ip&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_NOA_AC90_20250220_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=8318%2E5257348%2EER4tIZ)
---
But in all seriousness, from his first campaigns to writing legislation to make a difference in Californians’ lives, to serving as lead impeachment manager, Adam has been diligent and fiercely committed to the values we share.
Truth and honesty. Helping those in need. Defending the Constitution.
This continues to define his work in the Senate.
I believe that our country is filled with promise and that our democracy is precious. And fragile. Adam has been on the frontlines, protecting it. He always will be. And you have always been by his side. I am so grateful for that.
Thank you for being a part of this journey with Adam and me. It means so much to us to know you believe in Adam’s work and vision for our country. And to Adam, I’ll see you later for dinner and you better have picked a good vegan place!
[SHARE YOUR MARRIAGE ADVICE](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-202502-marriage-advice.Zrn3ip&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_NOA_AC90_20250220_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=8318%2E5257348%2EER4tIZ)
---

I’m proud to share this update with you, Peter.

I’ve introduced my first bill in Congress – the Chiquita Canyon Tax Relief Act. If passed, this bill would provide tax relief to residents in my district who have been affected by the Chiquita Canyon Landfill.

If you don’t know, the Chiquita Canyon Landfill has been cited numerous times for polluting the water, air, and land in nearby neighborhoods with toxic fumes. There’s no reason these residents should have to pay taxes on the much-needed assistance they need resulting from this environmental disaster.

This week, I visited families who have been affected, listened to their stories, and discussed the immediate need for assistance. There’s no sugarcoating it: This is a crisis, and CA-27 needs this bill.

My first bill is all about standing up for and lowering costs for our community. This is only the beginning, and I thank you for your continued support as I go to bat for you in Congress.

More to come,

George

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Jim Jordan is letting a billionaire rip Ohio apart
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Look, we know it’s easy to get overwhelmed by the sheer amount of nonsense coming at us everyday from the Trump and Jim Jordan agenda .
But just know:
We see what’s happening. We know who’s responsible. And we are taking the fight straight to them.
Donald Trump and his billionaire bestie Elon Musk are gutting the very programs that keep millions of Ohioans and Americans afloat.
Medicaid, food assistance, veteran benefits, public health funding—it’s all on the chopping block.
And Jim Jordan? He’s not just standing by—he’s cheering it on .
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=2025020_doge_ohio_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=2025020_doge_ohio_image]
This week, Jim Jordan went on record calling Trump and Musk “protectors of America.”
Tell that to the 3.5 million Ohioans who rely on Medicaid, the 830,000 veterans in Ohio who are now unsure if their benefits will still be there, or the seniors who don’t know if Meals on Wheels will still show up.
I get the calls. People call me, they email me, text me, they send me DM’s through social media telling me how scared they are that their check or benefits won’t be there on the 1st or 15th or whatever day they’re supposed to show up.
I can hear and feel the fear and anxiety in their tone. I gotta tell ya, it weighs heavy on me. I meant it when I say I think and care about the 800k constituents in my district. I cannot tell you how many sleepless nights I’ve had; that’s how seriously I take this job as a candidate.
Jordan isn’t fighting for everyday Americans, for our communities, or for the people who sent him to Washington. I AM!
He’s fighting for Trump’s authoritarian takeover. And you best believe we are fighting back.
We are taking the fight directly to Jim Jordan and his ULTRA-MAGA extremist allies. Will you chip in $25 or more today to help us hold them accountable? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=2025020_doge_ohio_link1]
Jordan and his cronies love to talk about “draining the swamp,” but what they’re really doing is dismantling government services that are there to hold them accountable and assist Ohio families.
The Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE)—Trump’s hand-picked agency designed to “cut waste”—isn’t saving taxpayers a dime.
They’re cutting American jobs forcing more people into financial insecurity and they want a pat on the back! HELL NO!
In fact, it’s costing us eight million dollars a day – that’s what Elon gets paid to fumble around our private data. Data BTW that is used for internet marketing. Insert my cyber security bill here! That data is being used to throw the entire federal government into chaos.
And instead of standing up for Ohioans, Jim Jordan is cozying up to Musk, doing his bidding, and helping push this disastrous agenda forward.
He’s selling us out, like he always does, plain and simple.
Even those who voted for Trump and Jordan in the fall weren’t asking for this chaos.
They weren’t asking for Medicaid cuts. They weren’t asking for veterans to be left in the dust. And we all know they weren’t asking to be fired!
And that means we have a real opportunity to bring them into this fight.
We can win. We can stop this. But it’s going to take all of us stepping up right now.
We’re building a movement to take Jim Jordan down. Will you rush a contribution today to power our fight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=2025020_doge_ohio_link2]
Jim Jordan might be letting Trump and Musk rip apart the country.
But we are on him. And we won’t let him win.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

**Peter, contraception is essential health care. Peter, I hear the same kind of frustrated reaction to Democratic fundraising a lot:
**_“Why the f*ck are you asking me for $5 when Trump is destroying our country and Democrats aren’t doing anything about it?”**_
I can’t speak for every group, but I do know what sets Leaders We Deserve apart.
We represent a generation of people who walked out of their schools, marching with millions of their peers to demand action on gun violence and mass shootings.
Young people are at the forefront of progressive movements, fighting for solutions on issues like gun reform, climate change, student debt, and Gaza, to name a few.
Now, these same young leaders are old enough to actually run for political office, right at the time when we need a massive movement of young people in power.
**Leaders We Deserve exists to transform these movements into political power.** Running for office is more expensive than ever — and these young leaders need our support to help lead their movements into state legislatures and Congress. We know that the billionaire class isn’t showing up to bankroll these campaigns, so it’s not an exaggeration to say they can’t win these fights without grassroots support.
**[Peter, can you contribute $5 to power our transformational movement?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250220-1?refcode=em20250220-1762&amount=5&refcode2=1762_587540_bCQdRc&akid=1762%2E587540%2EbCQdRc)**
**The young candidates that Leaders We Deserve supports are gamechangers. They will revitalize the Democratic Party and revolutionize our government.**
Our candidates are leading the fight to rebuild our political system. And they aren’t rebuilding the same political system that brought us school shootings, climate change, and all of the bullsh*t younger generations have to deal with in America.
They’re building something better — a system that actually _works_ for the people.
I believe that a big part of the answer to Donald Trump is building a movement of young people who will take back the reins of our government from the far right.
**Young people are up to this challenge.** If history has taught us anything, it's that great generations aren’t born, they’re made in the crucible of awful circumstances.
So when you give a donation to Leaders We Deserve, you aren’t just throwing out money at the status quo. You are investing in a different vision for what’s possible.
**[Please — pitch in $5 now to join our movement and fight for our future.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250220-1?refcode=em20250220-1762&amount=5&refcode2=1762_587540_bCQdRc&akid=1762%2E587540%2EbCQdRc)**

We can only do this work with your support. I deeply appreciate your generosity.
Thank you,
David Hogg

Peter, I hear the same kind of frustrated reaction to Democratic fundraising a lot: “Why the fck are you asking me for $5 when Trump is destroying our country and Democrats aren’t doing anything about it?” I can’t speak for every group, but I do know what sets Leaders We Deserve apart. We represent a generation of people who walked out of their schools, marching with millions of their peers to demand action on gun violence and mass shootings. Young people are at the forefront of progressive movements, fighting for solutions on issues like gun reform, climate change, student debt, and Gaza, to name a few. Now, these same young leaders are old enough to actually run for political office, right at the time when we need a massive movement of young people in power. Leaders We Deserve exists to transform these movements into political power. Running for office is more expensive than ever — and these young leaders need our support to help lead their movements into state legislatures and Congress. We know that the billionaire class isn’t showing up to bankroll these campaigns, so it’s not an exaggeration to say they can’t win these fights without grassroots support. The young candidates that Leaders We Deserve supports are gamechangers. They will revitalize the Democratic Party and revolutionize our government. Our candidates are leading the fight to rebuild our political system. And they aren’t rebuilding the same political system that brought us school shootings, climate change, and all of the bullsht younger generations have to deal with in America. They’re building something better — a system that actually works for the people. I believe that a big part of the answer to Donald Trump is building a movement of young people who will take back the reins of our government from the far right. Young people are up to this challenge. If history has taught us anything, it's that great generations aren’t born, they’re made in the crucible of awful circumstances. So when you give a donation to Leaders We Deserve, you aren’t just throwing out money at the status quo. You are investing in a different vision for what’s possible. We can only do this work with your support. I deeply appreciate your generosity. Thank you, David Hogg

| | Peter,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=94a9fd0b08b84325a686dceac5281d39&_e=ZUVcrMwCWjVJDnugk--yGT6NuwStbsMremyRzLfDgO0PHGVk7XNosJcCaV83vtK9aq2k5opQDpCCfwKsPzHaxdn06D765nGvU6fVF3e2Pz2p-8Jw_1C9ru6qa0cTEZ8KouYzNtAD_epF1jq6Huf0xWoji6Ifnaeuj9RvBLH4Z2WDqGt2RNMav5JHrqu3-VO8hhVq6dMShlZIr0dvpnZ9c5nizy72bqAQj5xHFwbjzK885ay3AgzVJ9phvpVp1_EnDlyrMRAmu3hpqocI8iTMvt1Cuo8Fq4ei7Ew3mKeZ2FANIfHXzEqFX9YogFLe3eLLMIHA4Fm22JgsmJP2hSFpHljgjexrOTNzogXBcqehl4hFCjG-PXrYfgnktO4P3bVXyo4wijWEXus9_KIBXDZU9HOlxB1z1jKPRWdbduCzUlG1Sv1MrBYWe4Pqbks4itXzBCzwZ7F-fKEKGUSRelc8aA%3D%3D)," now available on DVD.

clean_body: Watch the trailer A message from our sponsor... | | | | | Peter, Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture. But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult. To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "," now available on DVD. In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world. Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free?
