Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6darlts6z0mpcpnc2isna0giii2mvp41zqqb8ejr3nqun8jbu93d38sftpthxeiqz0k8xlfou7ag3imdkv5wrfq3315bvsebvxeyz23654t07l47vhbu0m20evn2rftkq5fn7nuraoqfqy11m8ap4&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss055y&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss055y&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss055y&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss055y&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6darlts6z0mpcpnc2isna0gijrorrezjok9447m6pa3c0jv5pbv1rxvctcw30c38ceepm0i88p0ucwu7a5re72yywqlntmbnvrmood37pfp38wlxjlvb9w19nj5ymd51ugobiirba2u8fxr7i419d&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss055y&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ss055y&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

GOP Senator Eric Schmitt **[HUMILIATED Kaitlan Collins during a tense interview](https://substack.com/redirect/305db118-8ec3-4852-998f-a1786654fa5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after she complained about Trump calling Zelensky a "dictator."
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/305db118-8ec3-4852-998f-a1786654fa5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

A hysterical Collins squawked, "I went to Ukraine last year and interviewed Zelensky. He was democratically elected in the first place against someone who was trying to take too much power. How do you hold an election in Ukraine right now?!"
Schmitt fired back, "Well we do it! We had one during the Civil War and we had an election in the middle of World War II! It's just hypocritical to claim you are a true free Democracy when you are unwilling to hold elections."
"I do find it interesting though Kaitlan, that the people who are screaming about this the loudest call president Trump a dictator all the time! The American media is so willing to criticize Trump-" he continued.
Collins interrupted, "Don't say the American media here! I've never called President Trump a dictator! That's an unfair criticism!"
Schmitt buried Collins' claims once and for all, "I don't think it's unfair! People on this very network called him a threat to democracy a thousand times!"

For those people—and you may be among them—I’m thrilled to share a digital copy of one of his commentaries with you, absolutely free: _[**_“_**** _Trickle Down” Theory and “Tax Cuts for the Rich._****_”_**](https://e.pm.tarise.com/re?l=D0I2xuecwvIteknop5I8ITm7e7xfwy&s=OECHGOKEBHJPNNJL)_

---
| | “Tax cuts for the rich” is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the federal government? Hoover Institution Senior Fellow **Thomas Sowell takes an empirical approach** in his commentary, [**_“_**** _Trickle Down” Theory and “Tax Cuts for the Rich._****_”_**](https://e.pm.tarise.com/re?l=D0I2xuecwvIteknop5IaITm7e7xfwy&s=OECHGOKEBHJPNNJL) Sowell separates fact from fiction when it comes to tax rates and uses real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all actually lead to greater revenue for the government. As a friend and supporter of the Hoover Institution, we are proud to offer you this valuable, thought-provoking resource free of charge. [**Click here to get your free copy of**** _ “Trickle Down” Theory and “Tax Cuts for the Rich” _****now.**](https://e.pm.tarise.com/re?l=D0I2xuecwvIteknop5IbITm7e7xfwy&s=OECHGOKEBHJPNNJL) Thanks, Greg Greg Stamps | _Online Development_ Hoover Institution | Stanford University

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Dallas weather: Temperatures in North Texas still dangerously cold,** " Dallas Morning News'**Lana Ferguson** -- "North Texans woke up to bone-chilling temperatures and [negative wind chills](https://substack.com/redirect/a8a455c5-0973-47fc-88e9-99d5e43dcc91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday morning with those conditions expected to last a little while longer.

The National Weather Service's extreme cold warning, which began Tuesday, expired 9 a.m. Thursday but the dangerously frigid weather was likely [remain until at least midday Friday](https://substack.com/redirect/6d259e64-1dfe-4b4d-ad01-1d84c8dc864a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The [wintry precipitation](https://substack.com/redirect/045ded81-7066-47be-8e71-f0beaa6f92a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) lasted a majority of the morning throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth area, weather service records show. It didn't really accumulate beyond trace amounts in the cities but some areas, especially south of lakes, had minor accumulations, according to the weather service.

"The dangerously cold wind chills as low as 10 below zero could [cause frostbite on exposed skin](https://substack.com/redirect/6a347190-246c-4858-88b6-40a0d5115a3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in as little as 30 minutes," weather officials warned, encouraging people to [dress in layers like a hat, face mask and gloves if outside](https://substack.com/redirect/6fd5408d-d0eb-4249-947f-01e2ad2c9dc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

As of midday Wednesday, wind chills at DFW International Airport dipped down to minus 8 multiple times while the coldest actual temperature in the morning was 12 degrees. Dallas Love Field Airport was slightly warmer with the chilliest wind chill of the morning reported as minus 7 with an actual temperature of 14.

These plunging temperatures compete with some of the coldest temperatures recorded for mid-February at DFW Airport. The coldest-ever Feb. 19 was 9 degrees in 1978, according to historic data, while the average temperatures for the date are a high of 62 and low of 41.

Wednesday's high temperature did set a daily record for Feb. 19 at DFW Airport. The high temperature of 28 degrees was the lowest maximum temperature for that date, breaking the old record of 31 degrees set Feb. 19, 1903, which was tied in 2006, according to the weather service.

[Road conditions remained mostly clear](https://substack.com/redirect/f7b309f8-b7b8-480d-a0a7-649b47b85a61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [some power outages were reported by Oncor](https://substack.com/redirect/28b67e38-af02-4619-b15e-c3910e431200?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) but they weren't sweeping. [ERCOT](https://substack.com/redirect/a4673afd-08a0-478d-b2cb-b6b0a2ba7c8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the electrical grid operator for most of Texas, [issued a weather watch](https://substack.com/redirect/bcd07bea-b8b9-4f26-a0dd-2e4e500275d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) through Friday but said grid conditions were expected to be normal. ...

Wind chills Wednesday night and Thursday morning in the Dallas-Fort Worth area were expected to be in the single digits, warming up into the teens by about noon Thursday then 20s later in the day. Temperatures may creep up to a high of 32 by the afternoon.

Friday's high temperature in Dallas is expected to rise above freezing.

Temperatures will warm up by the weekend with lows on Saturday slightly above freezing. There's also a slight chance of rain midday Saturday but the following few days are clear of precipitation.

High temperatures should be back in the 70s and 80s by Monday and Tuesday." [DMN](https://substack.com/redirect/c071256c-fb0b-44dd-a3a3-e3ac58467fd9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

body:
Once Stefanik is confirmed, she’ll resign her seat in Congress, and the race for the special election will officially begin.

| Elise Stefanik’s confirmation hearing to be President Trump’s Ambassador to the United Nations was last month.

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Dallas weather: Temperatures in North Texas still dangerously cold,** " Dallas Morning News'**Lana Ferguson** -- "North Texans woke up to bone-chilling temperatures and [negative wind chills](https://substack.com/redirect/d8f18fe0-6a1c-4893-a7c6-edb6af05963a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday morning with those conditions expected to last a little while longer.

The National Weather Service's extreme cold warning, which began Tuesday, expired 9 a.m. Thursday but the dangerously frigid weather was likely [remain until at least midday Friday](https://substack.com/redirect/ac1bb751-97d8-49d6-a0df-f2eadac66f25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The [wintry precipitation](https://substack.com/redirect/b48fbf49-e2e4-4506-a0dc-c60e86f2c814?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) lasted a majority of the morning throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth area, weather service records show. It didn't really accumulate beyond trace amounts in the cities but some areas, especially south of lakes, had minor accumulations, according to the weather service.

"The dangerously cold wind chills as low as 10 below zero could [cause frostbite on exposed skin](https://substack.com/redirect/7ca9f896-0d1c-40ad-907c-320fdc965f0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in as little as 30 minutes," weather officials warned, encouraging people to [dress in layers like a hat, face mask and gloves if outside](https://substack.com/redirect/845c1413-2a68-483f-852e-765e3f427ce1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

As of midday Wednesday, wind chills at DFW International Airport dipped down to minus 8 multiple times while the coldest actual temperature in the morning was 12 degrees. Dallas Love Field Airport was slightly warmer with the chilliest wind chill of the morning reported as minus 7 with an actual temperature of 14.

These plunging temperatures compete with some of the coldest temperatures recorded for mid-February at DFW Airport. The coldest-ever Feb. 19 was 9 degrees in 1978, according to historic data, while the average temperatures for the date are a high of 62 and low of 41.

Wednesday's high temperature did set a daily record for Feb. 19 at DFW Airport. The high temperature of 28 degrees was the lowest maximum temperature for that date, breaking the old record of 31 degrees set Feb. 19, 1903, which was tied in 2006, according to the weather service.

[Road conditions remained mostly clear](https://substack.com/redirect/2af7ae82-37e7-420e-85f3-0fae550b17c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [some power outages were reported by Oncor](https://substack.com/redirect/35b0a3c4-8d7d-4586-aac7-e084805ba401?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) but they weren't sweeping. [ERCOT](https://substack.com/redirect/801937bd-5505-4cb7-86aa-856353a27d4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the electrical grid operator for most of Texas, [issued a weather watch](https://substack.com/redirect/a52b9aea-c5b4-41ee-8a9a-abf568efe198?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) through Friday but said grid conditions were expected to be normal. ...

Wind chills Wednesday night and Thursday morning in the Dallas-Fort Worth area were expected to be in the single digits, warming up into the teens by about noon Thursday then 20s later in the day. Temperatures may creep up to a high of 32 by the afternoon.

Friday's high temperature in Dallas is expected to rise above freezing.

Temperatures will warm up by the weekend with lows on Saturday slightly above freezing. There's also a slight chance of rain midday Saturday but the following few days are clear of precipitation.

High temperatures should be back in the 70s and 80s by Monday and Tuesday." [DMN](https://substack.com/redirect/77be29a0-4434-47b5-83a1-920291ef2ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

competitive seats but the GOP in a relatively strong position to retain

Peter, This isn’t like last time around. For much of the first term, the Trump Administration’s incompetence tended to mitigate some of their malevolence. Even then, they still managed to do serious damage to our democracy and enact parts of an extreme agenda when the checks in our Constitutional system didn’t work as they should have. **But now, with a Republican-led Congress seemingly unwilling or incapable of standing up to this administration — or worse, eager to assist its most extreme power grabs — it’s clear that the best check left on Trump’s power is _us_.** _It’s the power of the people — a power that — history proves — is too often underestimated._ When they try to contort electoral maps to sculpt an electorate that’s friendlier to their partisan pursuit of power, it’s on us to push back in the name of fairness. When they try to undermine the census and even change the constitutional definition of citizenship, it’s on us to fight back with everything we’ve got. And when the voters head back to the polls, it’s on us to champion Democracy Defenders who will help right the ship and minimize the damage. clean_body: | Peter, This isn’t like last time around. For much of the first term, the Trump Administration’s incompetence tended to mitigate some of their malevolence. Even then, they still managed to do serious damage to our democracy and enact parts of an extreme agenda when the checks in our Constitutional system didn’t work as they should have. But now, with a Republican-led Congress seemingly unwilling or incapable of standing up to this administration — or worse, eager to assist its most extreme power grabs — it’s clear that the best check left on Trump’s power is us. It’s the power of the people — a power that — history proves — is too often underestimated. When they try to contort electoral maps to sculpt an electorate that’s friendlier to their partisan pursuit of power, it’s on us to push back in the name of fairness. When they try to undermine the census and even change the constitutional definition of citizenship, it’s on us to fight back with everything we’ve got. name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: 📱MAKE CALLS to help us stop bad bills / HAGA LLAMADAS para ayudarnos a detener las facturas incobrables 📱
body:
]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
TAKE ACTION:
Call your Texas lawmakers to fight restrictive, right-wing bills
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bad%20Bill%20Alert.png]
Texas Republicans in our state legislature are known for moving with lightning speed to shove through bad bills that attack our freedoms, and this legislative session is turning out to be no different. Just last week, GOP state senators in the Senate Committee on Criminal Justice passed two pieces of legislation — SB9 and SJR1 — that further chip away at our fundamental rights and our access to justice. We still have time to combat these bad bills in the legislative process, but we need your help NOW.
Help us make some calls this week! Let’s make clear that ALL who call our state home deserve to have their full rights respected.
SB9
This bill is a direct attack on pre-trial justice, expanding the harmful use of money bail and pre-trial detention, which disproportionately hurts everyday working-class Texans who simply cannot afford to buy their freedom. Share our graphic and call your legislators to urge them to oppose this legislation. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid0qoFuGxYNdryrveS5DDNqgNy8Fah9k7Qw7X3onHaQhMS58Zx7vw88rxU6aKjihhZ9l?rdid=WP8BV9lGx48UlGts]
SJR1
This problematic proposed constitutional amendment would unjustly deny bail for people charged with a felony offense simply because they are of undocumented immigrant status. Share our graphic and call your legislators to urge them to oppose this legislation. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid0qoFuGxYNdryrveS5DDNqgNy8Fah9k7Qw7X3onHaQhMS58Zx7vw88rxU6aKjihhZ9l?rdid=WP8BV9lGx48UlGts]
For more information on how to get involved in TOP's efforts to combat these bad legislative proposals and more, email Laquita at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
THIS SATURDAY in Houston:
Celebrate Black History Month and the power of our communities
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20History%20Month%20Houston%20event.jpg]
This Black History Month, TOP is celebrating the lives, contributions, and sacrifices of our ancestors whose tenacity has shaped us into who we are today. We invite you to join our TOP Harris County staff and members for a special community event THIS SATURDAY, February 22 in Houston.
Since our nation’s founding, Black Americans have been the cornerstone to its historic rise, the reason for its prosperity, and the protectors of its democracy. All the while, our communities continue to endure the many devious forms of white supremacy that seek to diminish us. While forces may try, we will never be defeated and our spirits never broken.
You still have time to RSVP! [https://secure.everyaction.com/pvBZtP2eEk-fU8Jizpv2hA2]
For more information, contact Gracie at garmijo@organizetexas.org [garmijo@organizetexas.org] .
Joining allies to protest dangerous policies criminalizing people without housing
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SA%20Cicero%20housing%20protest.JPG]
TOP Bexar County staff and members were proud to team up with pro-housing allies VOCAL Texas and others in Austin last week, as our groups called out proposed policies that further criminalize people in our state without housing. These out-of-touch proposals are being crafted and promoted by Cicero Institute [https://inthesetimes.com/article/joe-lonsdale-cicero-war-on-homeless] , a right-wing think tank based in the city.
Read more about last week's protest here. [https://www.kxan.com/news/local/austin/victims-of-cicero-protests-against-austin-based-think-tank/]
TOP's housing justice organizing is rooted in our fundamental belief that housing is a human right, and that all in our communities deserve a safe, affordable, and stable place to call home — no matter our age, race, gender, faith, or income.
For more information about this action, contact Michael at mnachebe@organizetexas.org [mnachebe@organizetexas.org] .
TOP Tip: Follow us on Bluesky
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bluesky.jpg]
TOP is now officially on Bluesky! With how toxic the public discourse on President Musk's X (Twitter) has become in recent weeks, TOP's Communications Team will be instead prioritizing the development of our presence on Bluesky. Follow us at @txorgproject.bsky.social! [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
Español
ACTÚE AHORA:
Llame a sus legisladores de Texas para que luchen contra los proyectos de ley restrictivos y de derecha
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/ALERTA%20DE%20MALA%20LEGISLACIO%CC%81N.png]
Los republicanos de Texas en nuestra legislatura estatal son conocidos por moverse rapidísimo para aprobar proyectos de ley malos que atacan nuestras libertades, y esta sesión legislativa no está siendo diferente. La semana pasada, los senadores estatales republicanos en el Comité Senatorial de Justicia Penal aprobaron dos proyectos de ley — SB9 y SJR1 — que socavan aún más nuestros derechos fundamentales y nuestro acceso a la justicia. Todavía tenemos tiempo para combatir estos proyectos de ley malos en el proceso legislativo, pero necesitamos su ayuda AHORA.
¡Ayúdenos a hacer algunas llamadas esta semana! Dejemos en claro que TODOS los que consideran nuestro estado su hogar merecen que se respeten sus derechos completos.
SB9
Este proyecto de ley es un ataque directo a la justicia previa al juicio, que amplía el uso nocivo de la fianza en efectivo y la detención previa al juicio, lo que perjudica desproporcionadamente a los texanos de clase trabajadora que simplemente no pueden permitirse comprar su libertad. Comparte nuestra gráfica y llama a tus legisladores para instarlos a oponerse a esta legislación. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid0qoFuGxYNdryrveS5DDNqgNy8Fah9k7Qw7X3onHaQhMS58Zx7vw88rxU6aKjihhZ9l?rdid=sQCcZfhJbP1CYuRt]
SJR1
Esta problemática propuesta de enmienda constitucional negaría injustamente la libertad bajo fianza a personas acusadas de un delito grave simplemente porque son inmigrantes indocumentados. Comparte nuestra gráfica y llama a tus legisladores para instarlos a oponerse a esta legislación. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid0qoFuGxYNdryrveS5DDNqgNy8Fah9k7Qw7X3onHaQhMS58Zx7vw88rxU6aKjihhZ9l?rdid=sQCcZfhJbP1CYuRt]
Para obtener más información sobre cómo participar en los esfuerzos de TOP para combatir estas malas propuestas legislativas y más, envíe un correo electrónico a Laquita a lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
ESTE SÁBADO en Houston:
Celebremos el Mes de la Historia Negra y el poder de nuestras comunidades
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20History%20Month%20Houston%20event.jpg]
Este Mes de la Historia Negra, TOP celebra las vidas, las contribuciones y los sacrificios de nuestros antepasados cuya tenacidad nos ha convertido en quienes somos hoy. Te invitamos a unirte al personal y miembros de TOP del condado de Harris para un evento comunitario especial ESTE SÁBADO, 22 de febrero en Houston.
Desde la fundación de nuestra nación, los afroamericanos han sido la piedra angular de su ascenso histórico, la razón de su prosperidad y los protectores de su democracia. Mientras tanto, nuestras comunidades siguen soportando las muchas formas perversas de supremacía blanca que buscan disminuirnos. Aunque las fuerzas lo intenten, nunca seremos derrotados y nuestro espíritu nunca se quebrará.
¡Aún tienes tiempo para confirmar tu asistenci [https://secure.everyaction.com/pvBZtP2eEk-fU8Jizpv2hA2] a!
Para obtener más información, comunícate con Gracie en garmijo@organizetexas.org [garmijo@organizetexas.org] .
Nos unimos a aliados para protestar contra politicas peligrosas que criminalizan a personas sin vivienda
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SA%20Cicero%20housing%20protest.JPG]
El personal y los miembros de TOP en Bexar County se enorgullecieron de trabajar en equipo con los aliados pro-vivienda VOCAL Texas y otros en Austin la semana pasada, cuando nuestros grupos denunciaron las políticas propuestas que criminalizan aún más a las personas sin vivienda en nuestro estado. Estas propuestas desfasadas están siendo elaboradas y promovidas por el Instituto Cicero [https://inthesetimes.com/article/joe-lonsdale-cicero-war-on-homeless] , un grupo de expertos de derecha con sede en la ciudad.
Lea más sobre la protesta de la semana pasada aquí. [https://www.kxan.com/news/local/austin/victims-of-cicero-protests-against-austin-based-think-tank/]
TOP organiza parar la justicia de vivienda y nuestra campaña se basa en nuestra creencia fundamental de que la vivienda es un derecho humano y que todos en nuestras comunidades merecen un lugar seguro, asequible y estable al que llamar hogar, sin importar nuestra edad, raza, género, fe o ingresos.
Para obtener más información sobre esta acción, comuníquese con Michael en mnachebe@organizetexas.org [mnachebe@organizetexas.org] .
Consejos de TOP: Siguenos en Bluesky
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bluesky.jpg]
¡TOP ya está oficialmente en Bluesky! En vista de lo tóxico que se ha vuelto el discurso público en la cuenta X (Twitter) del presidente Musk en las últimas semanas, el equipo de comunicaciones de TOP priorizará el desarrollo de nuestra presencia en Bluesky. ¡Síguenos en @txorgproject.bsky.social! Peter,

**[BIG NEWS:](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6367ee44be354a9b9431a55cf843919b&_e=uIlV74OilQC0PkTQk4sV2qjkq5nwu0yAGRiWC-bVvHY9gvjshs0MkCCKp_GbftFnygWk5im84NukSZfQoszIFIcMJYbZUsseG-Rag7i7h8fI4-wPbar1fbExCoVpW_9lEOdsUXOHJnALS5a3SdOxYvG6ocS3vT36vGH8-o2ucJmylZnkIwWYZnkvW9OjGHcYC9htaNXMcq_r47dFBej8a8BAdBvscEOHhfE4QNTK518rHsILXeLgtKoYLRLe1uMKJSNNHEiinLEGDyKRGCls5Jj6ch98bVmR-zCCl2FObO8gFzge8DD5DN6Y9M_58_--f7zRrbj_fg4FONDhDrX_7iuDmDuNRQdG7eoNmY80pnoH62Ws9fiqEkgKfo-tlNrdqjtUkThha_pfmI31jHVbik7cHM5dQOkKoscdrbCxnVLxDaG1lGMfLEtkSVMBYGqLvajQDFj5r6xeg3Z7bwvirpslkS-geKqn9BRRyiqh76kwdp-rxw2PJgESN5f8Hhms) **Republicans now have an 8-POINT LEAD over Democrats for control of the House and Senate.

But here's the thing...

_... None of that matters unless EVERY Republican completes and verifies their Voter Profile for 2025._

body:
| | | If the name Fani Willis sounds familiar to you, there's a reason.
---
| |
---
Dear Friend,If the name Fani Willis sounds familiar to you, there's a reason. She's the radical District Attorney in Georgia who's been abusing her office to target innocent police officers. And now she’s trying to lock my husband away for the _rest of his life_ for doing his job as a police officer and trying to keep our city safe. **Before I ask for your help, let me start at the beginning... ** My husband, James, served in the Atlanta Police Department. That's me, James, and our son in the photo I sent.
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=2fc6c56a8ea546628c9784da1e859951&_e=L8DT1RRyFUetLL3Qc1xw_9PyiTpFcPrU61KvbilRTUnofHPj4aTUpSPvh6LuF7zlOsG8TRHQBNIxfFN5ejosaBApYS2_DNeFHF5MReBrWnGsvmzfEK0dngNIpnyGkDnkUr8C3LRFp-7MzELrjAWCG72EOrUTxRiHWAyKX7b2H2P6z2VJP-VbvzCMLCg9T1jLgxPgwadqRnoZ7uN0D_-sGWduzGPuhwnf933tHwIukHPhpz9no-7H7CCw_bhb0w5HuJlimg4JWIC-9oU9LDZoal5nvDNAQXbTmxjlnilKbzfUD7A-6ZjfL9PbAEncLwNAR7G3TyLGliQ6POR6nwERaOzHgH70bfLNxIWWmTv5lDdxl8ariouO86cE2mbFDw9Fp9AKQ0TdyJqGudav7gvz2A%3D%3D)
---
Being a police officer meant the world to James. He was born and raised in Atlanta, and saw his job as a way to help his neighbors. But if Fani Willis has her way... **life in prison** could be his reward. Our nightmare started more than eight years ago, when my husband responded to a call about a man breaking into a parked car at an apartment complex. When he got there, he saw a running car parked facing the wrong way on a one-way street. With his emergency lights on, James got out to investigate. That's when it happened. The suspect saw my husband, slammed on the gas, and drove straight at him. With only a split second to think, James drew his weapon and fired a single shot at the vehicle bearing down on him. It struck the suspect, who died instantly. James was shaken by the incident, but thankfully he was unhurt. He went home, certain he had done everything by the book. **So you can imagine our shock when James found out he was being charged with murder!** You see, James is white, and the suspect he shot was black. So the woke, anti-police prosecutors in Atlanta have made it their mission to destroy my husband. Now you understand why I'm so upset and why **[**I'm turning to you for help.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=2fc6c56a8ea546628c9784da1e859951&_e=L8DT1RRyFUetLL3Qc1xw_9PyiTpFcPrU61KvbilRTUnofHPj4aTUpSPvh6LuF7zlOsG8TRHQBNIxfFN5ejosaBApYS2_DNeFHF5MReBrWnGsvmzfEK0dngNIpnyGkDnkUr8C3LRFp-7MzELrjAWCG72EOrUTxRiHWAyKX7b2H2P6z2VJP-VbvzCMLCg9T1jLgxPgwadqRnoZ7uN0D_-sGWduzGPuhwnf933tHwIukHObL5rHGjvHC6E7a2UQlFH46_aRruBhfLmKhymyQLAr0YMbU-rSHHZcrfQ2E1BFVspxpM643bJfiYCGon9Hb5-RuxZsbR5xQudS5Uq7mArqnIFw_HDyDtc0jujDR9R7aXLrezOorOrZTKBiCZshq3D-BvHfOxLij3lTwChCh7pwGg%3D%3D)** James is an honest, hardworking, good-hearted man who only wants to help people. My husband is exactly the kind of man you want keeping your city safe. But none of that matters to radical prosecutors like Fani Willis. She knows what happened that night. She knows James was in a life-or-death situation. She knows that the charge should have been dropped years ago. Fanni Willis just wants to make an example out of my husband. For years, we've been trapped in limbo. We've lost nearly all our friends, and we've even been forced to move because of the terrible lies the prosecutors have been spreading about my husband. By some miracle, we've been able to get by, but every day is difficult. And what's been truly overwhelming is the cost of James' legal defense. Earlier this year, we ran out of money. We had all but given up hope... **And then we got a call from Jason Johnson, the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund, or LELDF. ** If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongfully-accused police officers like James. Not only did the LELDF board decide to help my husband get the legal defense he deserves, they're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys so James can finally clear his name. That's why I'm writing to you today to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone... **[Could you send a contribution today to help defend James?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=2fc6c56a8ea546628c9784da1e859951&_e=L8DT1RRyFUetLL3Qc1xw_9PyiTpFcPrU61KvbilRTUnofHPj4aTUpSPvh6LuF7zlOsG8TRHQBNIxfFN5ejosaBApYS2_DNeFHF5MReBrWnGsvmzfEK0dngNIpnyGkDnkUr8C3LRFp-7MzELrjAWCG72EOrUTxRiHWAyKX7b2H2P6z2VJP-VbvzCMLCg9T1jLgxPgwadqRnoZ7uN0D_-sGWduzGPuhwnf933tHwIukHOvcVYoG3VDn3kHvcDdkFXH8ox2orWUwrwB3FSe2QQ5cGJFqBVMQv2zhNeKjMXwubkRdd18IMQ949Ng9vmhI8rP86-yaLCOVqfUq8csU4VuxP7voFIOpKisSa0_fMX2Hw-1TPnTW78fpYYVPQkesBklkNghLoFE5qKHBahvjSBb7w%3D%3D) ** His legal team needs to be working day and night to get ready to defeat Fani Willis's team and get my husband declared NOT GUILTY once and for all. We have nowhere else to turn. And I'm so scared for what will happen to my husband. **[So, if you're at all able, would you consider making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or $1,000 to LELDF to help wrongfully-accused officers like James?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=2fc6c56a8ea546628c9784da1e859951&_e=L8DT1RRyFUetLL3Qc1xw_9PyiTpFcPrU61KvbilRTUnofHPj4aTUpSPvh6LuF7zlOsG8TRHQBNIxfFN5ejosaBApYS2_DNeFHF5MReBrWnGsvmzfEK0dngNIpnyGkDnkUr8C3LRFp-7MzELrjAWCG72EOrUTxRiHWAyKX7b2H2P6z2VJP-VbvzCMLCg9T1jLgxPgwadqRnoZ7uN0D_-sGWduzGPuhwnf933tHwIukHMD_4hcG_to_u6mHg4lGmNhZxUBUK539BwkTWwF--LKUH6I-LFHQv0vu2fpoVC9bBUEoIcqiTLyLWKr7puhfxyu_o_1t5ypmwmJKm_cEV57bf3DTBQ92E3erGorXOn6F1FYKsvGZwIlTCyzufigDM1PO-jusuy2X-TSj8hf1AwQBw%3D%3D) ** It's your **[**$35 gift**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=2fc6c56a8ea546628c9784da1e859951&_e=L8DT1RRyFUetLL3Qc1xw_9PyiTpFcPrU61KvbilRTUnofHPj4aTUpSPvh6LuF7zlOsG8TRHQBNIxfFN5ejosaBApYS2_DNeFHF5MReBrWnGsvmzfEK0dngNIpnyGkDnkUr8C3LRFp-7MzELrjAWCG72EOrUTxRiHWAyKX7b2H2P6z2VJP-VbvzCMLCg9T1jLgxPgwadqRnoZ7uN0D_-sGWduzGPuhwnf933tHwIukHO286je07_9bw551Q9gyMp1cYCwbIqco_dnPMPRL9rkYas5hXaiUteRXfbp9sKWtgEwAR10WUIUJAe_T1GWCKwiIU0NhzuaMiIUYDhxKxNfwpLPmf1VNC0BKEj0lRBD2LtKNSVOEQzqtJH0K8W3cAOOrxXaw6LIVokP3hZRltVYzA%3D%3D)** that could make the difference between defeating Fani Willis and the radical anti-police prosecutors on her team -- and my husband spending the rest of his life in prison. Thank you for taking the time to read about my husband. And thank you in advance for helping my James.
---
Sincerely,
---
Jenna Burns
---
P.S. My husband did EVERYTHING he needed to survive that night. He doesn't deserve to die in prison. But that's EXACTLY what will happen if radical prosecutor Fani Willis gets her way. Please help James before it's too late! **[Follow this link right now to make your best tax-deductible gift of $35 or more to LELDF.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=2fc6c56a8ea546628c9784da1e859951&_e=L8DT1RRyFUetLL3Qc1xw_9PyiTpFcPrU61KvbilRTUnofHPj4aTUpSPvh6LuF7zlOsG8TRHQBNIxfFN5ejosaBApYS2_DNeFHF5MReBrWnGsvmzfEK0dngNIpnyGkDnkUr8C3LRFp-7MzELrjAWCG72EOrUTxRiHWAyKX7b2H2P6z2VJP-VbvzCMLCg9T1jLgxPgwadqRnoZ7uN0D_-sGWduzGPuhwnf933tHwIukHPSG3w1kK8X60zDSPMrbWcaZhgRIX6rxb14Z7wjjNQuFQWIfrzHVLmJwPj0stcfmAN12bAigMBYraagvRA0w_DqK4a0VHhJPiuTiXZ66buwj8F_mm6p8kVXjObugR2vBROFrRfRasmfLX1ITej48A-M-He5673LVG7bC2OesmkECw%3D%3D) **Thank you for helping me save my husband and my family.
---
|
---

Folks,

In my first term as governor, Kentucky was hit with devastating floods, historic tornadoes, and a global pandemic. When these disasters hit and entire communities needed to rebuild, no one cared how their neighbor voted in the last election, or what box they checked on their voter registration when they turned 18. What was important was that Kentuckians were in this together.

That’s something I’ve always remembered.

In 2023, Kentucky showed the nation that decency, compassion, and courage are the ingredients to a winning formula. We won big that November by sticking to our shared values, promoting unity over division, and rejecting the anger politics that have come to dominate our country.

**We have a roadmap to winning elections in tough states, and want to replicate our success both here in Kentucky and across the country.**

That’s why, I'm excited to introduce you to **In This Together PAC.** In This Together is here to support good people and good candidates running for local, statewide, and federal office in red or purple states. These candidates demonstrate a commitment to leading with empathy, compassion, and the backbone to always do what’s right, _regardless of politics._

body:
Americans did not elect Elon Musk.
---
Derek, We’re about to ask you to donate directly to the DNC to help us build a strong Democratic Party that will fight back against Trump and his extreme billionaire allies. If that’s all you need to hear, you can use this link to pitch in: [**https://democrats.org/go/February**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-february-2025?amount=3&refcode=em_20250220_2824_fr&refcode2=2824_22930333_bmuxv7&akid=2824%2E22930333%2Ebmuxv7) Otherwise, we hope you’ll give us a chance to explain why your support is so important right now: Americans did not elect Elon Musk. Musk has targeted agencies like the IRS, Social Security, the CFPB, and more.
